examples.zh: 我们参观小镇时，那里的人们对我们很友好。

examples.en: Jenny likes the new neighbourhood because people here are friendly.
examples.zh: 珍妮喜欢新小区，因为这儿的人很友好。

teaching_notes.content:
friendly是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记在中考考纲中有4个以-1y结尾
的形容词，friendly是其中的一个，其他三个是：lovely, silly, early。

examples.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
examples.zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

examples.en: What makes you happy in life? Perhaps it is the love of your family or the friendship of your classmates.
examples.zh: 是什么使你的生活快乐?也许是你家人的爱或是同学的友谊。

examples.en: Even a mouse can frighten a guilty man.
examples.zh: 做贼心虚。

examples.en: My dog is gentle and never bites, so you needn't be frightened.
examples.zh: 我的狗很温驯，从不咬人，所以你不必害怕。

examples.en: My trip to Phuket Island was really a frightening experience.
examples.zh: 我的普吉岛之旅真是一次可怕的经历。

teaching_notes.content:
frightened是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与frightening的用法区别：
frightened用于形容人的感受，frightening用于形容事物。
例如：Lili is frightened of cockroaches.莉莉很怕蟑螂。
The forest was very dark and frightening.森林很黑暗恐怖。

meanings.meaning: (表示起点)从；自；(表示时间)从⋯⋯开始；(表示距离)离⋯⋯

examples.en: How far is it from the office to your home?
examples.zh: 从办公室到你家有多远?

examples.en: One starry night, when the seven little dwarfs went back home from work, they found something unusual at once.
examples.zh: 一个星光灿烂的夜晚，当七个小矮人下班回家，他们立刻发现了一些不同寻常的东西。

examples.en: The meeting will last from 2p.m.to 4 p.m.
examples.zh: 会议将从下午2点持续到4点。

examples.en: The restaurant is only a few blocks away from my house.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅离我家只有几个街区的距离。

examples.en: She received some gifts from her friend.
examples.zh: 她收到了来自朋友的礼物。

usage_notes: 距⋯⋯;(表示来源)来自

examples.en: I can see Hieks at the library from time to time.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆有时能看见希克斯。

examples.en: The front seats are sold out.
examples.zh: 前排的座位已经售罄。

examples.en: I'm in front of you.
examples.zh: 我在你前面。

examples.en: I don't think I like frozen food. It's not fresh.
examples.zh: 我想我不喜欢冷冻食品。它不新鲜。

examples.en: It's important to eat a variety of fruits and vegetables.
examples.zh: 吃各种各样的水果和蔬菜很重要。

examples.en: She is frying eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她正在煎鸡蛋做早餐。

examples.en: They ran out of fuel.
examples.zh: 他们的燃料用完了。

meanings.meaning: 满的，充满的；完全的；饱的

examples.en: If you are full of confidence,you'll be happy all the time.
examples.zh: 如果你充满自信，你会一直开开心心。

examples.en: I fully understand your feelings.
examples.zh: 我完全理解你的感受。

meanings.meaning: 乐趣；有趣的事；娱乐；玩笑；快乐

examples.en: What great fun it is to have a barbecue in the park on such a sunny day!
examples.zh: 在这样一个晴朗的日子，在公园烧烤是多么有趣啊!

examples.en: It is not nice to make fun of someone because of their appearance.
examples.zh: 因为别人的外貌而取笑他们是不好的。

examples.en: Mark Twain's stories are funny and full of surprising events of his childhood.
examples.zh: 马克·吐温的故事很有趣，里面都是他童年时期的奇闻趣事。

examples.en: I wonder if the floor can support such a weight of furniture.
examples.zh: 我不知这地板能否承受住这样重的家具。

teaching_notes.content:
furniture是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道：像 furniture,fun, music,advice,
weather,information,news等这些词都是不可数名词。

examples.en: Now we live further away from the city centre.
examples.zh: 现在我们住得离市中心更远了。

examples.en: She took the new job to further her career.
examples.zh: 她接受了这项新工作以进一步发展她的事业。

examples.en: We need further consideration on this matter.
examples.zh: 我们需要更深入地考虑此事。

examples.en: We should take serious responsibilities and work for a better future.
examples.zh: 我们应当承担起重大的责任，为更美好的未来而努力。

examples.en: Gaining knowledge through experience is more valuable than learning from books.
examples.zh: 通过实践获得知识比从书本上学更有价值。

examples.en: No pain,no gain.
examples.zh: 一份耕耘，一份收获。

examples.en: Online games are very interesting, but we can't spend too much time on them.
examples.zh: 网络游戏很有趣，但我们不能花太多时间。

examples.en: Football is a team game.
examples.zh: 足球是一项团队运动。

examples.en: The game lasted 2 hours.
examples.zh: 比赛进行了两个小时。

examples.en: There is a small gap between the two boards.
examples.zh: 两块木板之间有个小缝隙。

examples.en: We park our car in the garage.
examples.zh: 我们把车停在车库里。

examples.en: How happily Little Tommy is playing with his cousin in the garden!
examples.zh: 小汤米和他的表弟在花园里玩耍多么快乐!

examples.en: I don't like the smell of garlic.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢大蒜的味道。

examples.en: A lot of gases are harmful.
examples.zh: 有许多气体是有害的。

examples.en: A friend of theirs is waiting for the manager at the gate of the company.
examples.zh: 他们的一个朋友正在公司门口等经理。

examples.en: He bought some new fishing gear.
examples.zh: 他买了一些新的钓鱼用具。

meanings.meaning: 大体的，笼统的；总的；全体的；普遍的

examples.en: This is the general trend.
examples.zh: 这是总体趋势。

examples.en: A soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier.
examples.zh: 不想当将军的士兵不是好士兵。

examples.en: Some famous speeches in history have left a lasting impact on future generations.
examples.zh: 历史上一些著名的演讲对后世产生了深远的影响。

examples.en: She is a warmhearted,generous old lady.
examples.zh: 她是一位热心、慷慨的老太太。

examples.en: I want to play with the gentle cat.
examples.zh: 我想和那只温驯的猫玩耍。

examples.en: I am a gentleman.
examples.zh: 我是一个绅士。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we'll arrive in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 女士们、先生们，我们将到达上海。

examples.en: He picked the injured bird up gently.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地捡起受伤的小鸟。

teaching_notes.content:
gently是常考单词，是由形容词gentle 转换而来。学生一定要牢记在中考
考纲中有些形容词去e再加y 即可转换为副词，如：possible—possibly(可能，
也许),simple—simply(简单地),terrible—terribly(可怕地)。

examples.en: Geography is an important subject.
examples.zh: 地理是一门很重要的学科。

examples.en: He made a gesture of welcome when he saw his friend.
examples.zh: 他看到朋友时做了一个欢迎的手势。

examples.en: The tour guide gestured for the group to follow him.
examples.zh: 导游做手势示意团队跟着他。

meanings.meaning: 成为；变得；得到；到达；(用于have got

examples.en: After taking tennis classes, Tim is getting much stronger than he was one year ago.
examples.zh: 上了网球课之后，蒂姆比一年前强壮多了。—She looked unhappy today.What's wrong with her?—She got a “D”in English.——她今天看上去不高兴。她怎么了?——英语她得了一个“D”。

examples.en: I got to the station at half past four.
examples.zh: 我于4点半到达车站。

examples.en: Lucy has got a lovely pet dog. Its name is Taffy.
examples.zh: 露西有一条可爱的宠物狗。它的名字叫“太妃糖”。

usage_notes: 短语中)具有

meanings.meaning: /on(with)进展；与⋯⋯相处；和睦相处；关系良好

examples.en: I’m sure you'll get on well with your classmates if you are kind and friendly to them.
examples.zh: 如果你对同班同学和蔼友好，我敢肯定你会与他们相处融洽的。

examples.en: She wants to get away from the noisy city for a few days.
examples.zh: 她想离开喧闹的城市几天。

examples.en: We should get into the habit of keeping good hours.
examples.zh: 我们应该养成早睡早起的习惯。

examples.en: As soon as he got off the bus, the poor man realized he had left his wallet on it.
examples.zh: 一下车，这个可怜人就意识到他把钱包遗忘在车上了。

examples.en: The bus is coming. Be careful when you get on the bus.
examples.zh: 车来了。上车时小心。

examples.en: Our class teacher asked us if we had got ready for the final exams.
examples.zh: 老师问我们是否已为期末考试做好了准备。

examples.en: Jane gets angry easily. She'd better get rid of it.
examples.zh: 简容易发怒。她最好改掉这个毛病。

examples.en: I never get tired of watching the landscape.
examples.zh: 我对这景色百看不厌。

examples.en: Have we got to the zoo yet?
examples.zh: 我们到动物园了吗?

examples.en: Yesterday morning I got up early so as not to be late for the exam.
examples.zh: 为了考试不迟到，昨天早上我很早起床。

examples.en: The giant pumpkin at the fall festival weighed over 500 pounds, breaking the previous record.
examples.zh: 秋收节上这只巨大的南瓜超过了500磅，打破了之前的纪录。

examples.en: The giant in the fairy tale lived in a castle high atop the mountain.
examples.zh: 童话故事里的巨人住在山顶上的城堡里。

examples.en: It's our family tradition to exchange gifts on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 在除夕夜交换礼物是我们家的传统。

examples.en: A giraffe is an animal which has a long neck.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿是一种脖子很长的动物。

examples.en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 对于这样一个小女孩，在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

examples.en: What a useful suggestion you have given me!
examples.zh: 你给我的建议是多么有用啊!

examples.en: On leaving school,all the students felt thankful to the teachers for giving them a good education.
examples.zh: 离开学校时，所有的学生都感谢老师给了他们良好的教育。

examples.en: The youth gave me his hand when I was lifting my baggage.
examples.zh: 当我正要提起行李时，那个年轻人帮了我。

examples.en: Never giving up is certainly one of the key factors for the old man's achievement.
examples.zh: 永不放弃无疑是这位老人取得成就的关键因素之一。

teaching_notes.content:
give up是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：give up sth.与stop sth.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: I am glad to hear from you.
examples.zh: 我很高兴收到你的来信。

examples.en: I will be glad to do it for you.
examples.zh: 我很乐意为你做这件事。

examples.en: It is said that eight glasses of water a day can help you keep fit.
examples.zh: 有人说，每天8杯水可以帮助你保持健康。

examples.en: The glasses are made of fine glass.
examples.zh: 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。

examples.en: He stuck his gloves in his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把手套塞进口袋里。

examples.en: The fireflies glow in the dark.
examples.zh: 萤火虫在黑暗中发光。

examples.en: Could you use glue to stick the fabric onto the paper?
examples.zh: 你能用胶水将布料粘在纸上吗?

examples.en: They are glued together.
examples.zh: 它们被粘贴在一起。

proverbs.text: Pride goes before a fall.

examples.en: Mike hurt one of his feet in an accident yesterday. Shall we go and see him after school?
examples.zh: 昨天的事故中迈克伤了一只脚。放学后我们去看看他好吗?

examples.en: I won't go to the party unless I’m invited.
examples.zh: 除非我受到邀请，否则我不会去参加聚会。

teaching_notes.content:
go是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握have gone to, have been to, have been
in的用法区别：
have gone to意为“到某地去”,说话时该人不在现场，一般不用第一人称和第
二人称代词作句子的主语。
例如：—Where is Jim?吉姆在哪里?
—He has gone to England.他去英国了。(尚未回来)
Mr.Wang isn't here. He has gone to Qingdao.
王先生不在这里。他去青岛了。
have been to意为“曾经去过某地”,现在已不在那里了。后可接表示次数的词，
如once,twice,three times等，也可和before,just, never,ever等词连用。
例如：My father has been to Beijing twice.我父亲去过北京两次。
I have never been to the Great Wall.我从未去过长城。
have been in表示“在某地待了多少时间”,句尾常接 for+ 时间段，或since+
时间点，或句首有How long。
例如：I have been in Shanghai for three years.我到上海已有3年了。

meanings.meaning: 先走；向前走；去吧；干吧；继续；着手做

examples.en: Cross the street and go ahead.
examples.zh: 过马路，一直往前走。—Do you mind if I open the window?你介意我开窗吗?—Not at all. Go ahead.完全不会，你开吧。

examples.en: I go to the gym for a swim.
examples.zh: 我去健身房游泳。

examples.en: They may go hiking around the island, or swimming in the ocean.
examples.zh: 他们可以环岛徒步旅行或在海里游泳。

examples.en: After the movie,we went home.
examples.zh: 看完电影，我们就回家了。

examples.en: Which events is he going in for at the Olympics?
examples.zh: 他将在奥运会上参加什么项目?

examples.en: They wanted me to go in for film work.
examples.zh: 他们要我从事电影工作。

examples.en: Many people go in for golf.
examples.zh: 许多人喜欢打高尔夫球。

teaching_notes.content:
go in for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：go in for与take part in意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: The lights went off suddenly because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因为大雨，灯突然断电了。

teaching_notes.content:
go off为多义短语，还可表示“闹钟响；爆炸；变质”。
例如：My alarm clock goes off at six every morning.我的闹钟每天早上6点响。
We heard a big noise when the balloon went off.
气球爆炸的时候我们听到了一声巨响。
Check the date on the juice carton to make sure it hasn't gone off.
检查一下果汁盒上的日期，确保它还没变质。

examples.en: Now(that) he is well again, he can go on with his English study.
examples.zh: 现在他既已恢复了健康，就可以继续学习英语了。

teaching_notes.content:
go on是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：go on与continue意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: Maybe you need to go on a diet.
examples.zh: 或许你应当节食了。

examples.en: Mr. Smith will go on a picnic this Saturday unless the weather is bad.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生将于本周六去野餐，除非天气不好去不了。

examples.en: They went on with their basketballmatch in spite of the rain.
examples.zh: 他们冒雨继续进行篮球比赛。

examples.en: He went on reading the text.
examples.zh: 他继续读这篇课文。

examples.en: The concert lasted only a few minutes before the power went out.
examples.zh: 音乐会只持续了几分钟就停电了。

examples.en: You may fail to pass the examination unless you do your best to go over the lessons.
examples.zh: 除非你尽力复习，否则你可能无法通过考试。

examples.en: I want to go sailing to relax myself.
examples.zh: 我想去航海放松一下。

examples.en: Since the rain has stopped, why not go shopping now?
examples.zh: 现在既然雨停了，为什么不去购物呢?

examples.en: Did you go sightseeing last Sunday?
examples.zh: 上星期天你是否去观光游览了?

examples.en: After feeling unwell for several days,John decided to go to the hospital.
examples.zh: 难受了几天，约翰决定还是去医院看一下。

examples.en: It is time for me to go to bed.
examples.zh: 我睡觉的时间到了。

examples.en: I would like all my children to go to college.
examples.zh: 我希望我的孩子们都考上大学。

examples.en: How do you go to school?
examples.zh: 你怎么去上学?

examples.en: I am too excited to go to sleep.
examples.zh: 我太兴奋了，睡不着。

examples.en: She wished to go to the cinema/movie(s)yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天想去看电影。

examples.en: Your computer will go wrong without any anti-virus software.
examples.zh: 你的电脑没有任何杀毒软件会出问题的。

examples.en: Finally,Jack achieved his goal and became the owner of a company.
examples.zh: 最后，杰克实现了他的目标，成为了一家公司的老板。

examples.en: She kicked the ball into the net, scoring a goal for her team.
examples.zh: 她把球踢进球网，为球队得了分。

examples.en: The goalkeeper made a great save.
examples.zh: 守门员做出了一次精彩的扑救。

examples.en: The goat is eating grass.
examples.zh: 山羊在吃草。

examples.en: Thor was the Viking god of thunder.
examples.zh: 索尔是维京人的雷神。

examples.en: Fire is the test of gold.
examples.zh: 真金不怕火炼。

examples.en: Her hair is golden.
examples.zh: 她的头发是金黄色的。

examples.en: My father likes to play golf on weekends.
examples.zh: 我父亲喜欢在周末打高尔夫球。

proverbs.text: All things in their being are good for something.

examples.en: Nadal is a good tennis player,but I think Djokovic is better.
examples.zh: 纳达尔是一名优秀的网球运动员，但我认为德约科维奇更优秀。

examples.en: They came to the front door to wave goodbye.
examples.zh: 他们来到前门挥手告别。

examples.en: The shop sells all kinds of daily goods.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售各类日用品。

examples.en: There is a group of geese swimming in the pond.
examples.zh: 池塘里游着一群鹅。

examples.en: The government is going to widen the road this coming summer.
examples.zh: 政府打算今年夏天拓宽道路。

meanings.meaning: 等级；(中小学的)学年，年级；成绩，分数

examples.en: Kitty is in Grade Eight.
examples.zh: 姬蒂读八年级。

examples.en: He received a failing grade.
examples.zh: 他得了一个不及格的成绩。

examples.en: Mum has been working in this school since she graduated from university in 2000.
examples.zh: 妈妈自2000年大学毕业后就一直在这所学校工作。

examples.en: Li Fang is a graduate of Fudan University.
examples.zh: 李芳是一名复旦大学的毕业生。

examples.en: Farmers grow different kinds of grains.
examples.zh: 农民种不同种类的谷物。

examples.en: Understanding grammar is essential for writing clear and effective sentences.
examples.zh: 理解语法对于写出清晰有效的句子至关重要。

examples.en: Does Jane often read newspapers to her 90-year-old grandma after school?
examples.zh: 放学后，简经常给她90岁的奶奶读报吗?

examples.en: My grandpa is so forgetful that he always leaves things about.
examples.zh: 我的爷爷很健忘，他总是到处丢东西。

examples.en: Wine is made from grapes.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿制而成。

examples.en: She was very frightened at the sight of a snake on the grass.
examples.zh: 看到草地上的蛇，她很害怕。

examples.en: I’m very grateful to my teacher for her help.
examples.zh: 我非常感激老师对我的帮助。

meanings.meaning: 伟大的；重要的；<口>好极了，很好

proverbs.text: Great hopes make great man.
proverbs.meaning: 远大的理想造就伟大的人物。

examples.en: The great ship Titanic went down into the water and over 1,500 lives were lost.
examples.zh: 巨轮“泰坦尼克号”沉入水中，1500多人失去了生命。

examples.en: We are very thankful to our teachers for their great help.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢老师给予的巨大帮助。

examples.en: It is great for me to see her.
examples.zh: 看见她对我来说真好。

examples.en: The greedy boy ate allthe cakes.
examples.zh: 那个贪婪的男孩把所有蛋糕都吃了。

examples.en: Don't start moving the car until the traffic lights change to green.
examples.zh: 交通信号灯变绿之前，不要启动汽车。

examples.en: I like green grass.
examples.zh: 我喜欢青草。

examples.en: There are a lot of beans in the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 暖房里有许多豆子。

meanings.meaning: 问候；打招呼；欢迎；向⋯⋯致敬

examples.en: When you first meet the interviewer,greet him or her politely.
examples.zh: 当你第一次见到面试官时，必须有礼貌地向他或她打招呼。

meanings.meaning: 灰色的；烟灰色的；灰白色的

examples.en: The sky turned a dark grey before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临前天空变成了深灰色。

examples.en: I'll take the grey jacket.
examples.zh: 我要那件灰色夹克衫。

examples.en: Look out! There is a dead cat on the ground.
examples.zh: 小心!地上有一只死猫!

examples.en: The STEM course in our school requires students to do some projects in groups.
examples.zh: 我们学校的STEM课程要求学生分组完成一些项目。

meanings.meaning: 生长；发育；种植，栽种；逐渐变得

examples.en: She has grown up.
examples.zh: 她长大了!

examples.en: Grandpa grew vegetables in his garden.
examples.zh: 爷爷在他的园子里种了蔬菜。

examples.en: As the days passed, her love for literature grew stronger.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，她对文学的热爱变得愈发强烈。

usage_notes: 逐渐成为

examples.en: Children must be educated to serve their country when they grow up.
examples.zh: 必须教育孩子长大后为国家效力。

meanings.meaning: (尤指用于对儿童说话时)大人

examples.en: The grown-ups are talking.
examples.zh: 大人们在说话。

examples.en: Good food helps the growth of children.
examples.zh: 良好的食物有助于儿童的成长。

examples.en: The guards were ordered not to leave their posts.
examples.zh: 警卫受命不得擅离岗位。

examples.en: Soldiers guard the frontier against invasion.
examples.zh: 战士们守卫边疆，防止外敌入侵。

examples.en: I guess you are right.
examples.zh: 我想你是对的!

examples.en: His guess about the outcome of the game turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他对比赛结果的猜测是正确的。

examples.en: All the guests are pleased with the restaurant for its excellent service.
examples.zh: 所有的客人都对这家餐厅的优质服务表示满意。

examples.en: The teacher's guidance helped me a lot.
examples.zh: 老师的指导对我帮助很大。

examples.en: You can follow the guide.
examples.zh: 你可以跟着导游。

examples.en: Can you pass me the travel guide?
examples.zh: 你能将旅行指南递给我吗?

examples.en: The GPS system guided us safely to our destination in the unfamiliar city.
examples.zh: 在陌生的城市里，导航系统将我们安全引到了目的地。

examples.en: She was trying to teach him to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 她在试着教他弹吉他。

examples.en: Put the gun down!
examples.zh: 把枪放下!

examples.en: Our school has a big gym.
examples.zh: 我们学校有座大型体育馆。

examples.en: To improve your writing skills, you'd better develop a habit of reading.
examples.zh: 为了提高写作技巧，你最好养成阅读习惯。

examples.en: The destruction of the forest has greatly affected the habitat of wild animals.
examples.zh: 森林的破坏极大地影响了野生动物的栖息地。

examples.en: You'd better eat a healthy diet, and more importantly, do exercise regularly.
examples.zh: 你最好养成健康的饮食习惯，更重要的是，定期做运动。

examples.en: You had better not forget to bring a power bank when you travel.
examples.zh: 你去旅行最好不要忘了带充电宝。

examples.en: The beautiful girl has long hair.
examples.zh: 这个美丽的小女孩有一头长发。

examples.en: I have an appointment with my hairdresser tomorrow for a haircut.
examples.zh: 我明天约了理发师剪头发。

proverbs.text: Never do things by halves.

examples.en: Joe spent nearly half a year planning his journey around the world.
examples.zh: 乔用了将近半年的时间来规划他的环球之旅。

examples.en: We will meet at half past four.
examples.zh: 我们将在4点半集合。

teaching_notes.content:
half是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下表示“半小时或一个半小时”
的固定搭配和数词的习惯用法。
half an hour半小时
one hour and a half=one and a half hours一个半小时
two hundred students=two hundred of the students 200名学生
hundreds of students许多学生，数百名学生
one-third of the students 三分之一的学生
two-thirds of the students三分之二的学生
a ten-year-old boy一个10岁的男孩
The boy is ten years old.这个男孩10岁。
He is over fifty years old.他已过了50岁。
He is in his fifties.他50多岁了。
It's ten minutes'walk.=It's a ten-minute walk.需要步行10分钟。

examples.en: There was hardly anything interesting in today's party. We all lft the hall early.
examples.zh: 今天的派对几乎没什么有趣的。我们都很早离开了会堂。

examples.en: Would you like to eat a hamburger?
examples.zh: 你想吃一个汉堡吗?

examples.en: He used a hammer to fix the table.
examples.zh: 他用锤子修理桌子。

examples.en: Although Liu Wei has no hands, he can play the piano very beautifully.
examples.zh: 虽然刘伟没有手，但他能非常优美地弹奏钢琴。

examples.en: He handed me the glass.
examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯递给了我。

examples.en: Hand in please!
examples.zh: 请交上来!

examples.en: What a disappointing excuse you've made when failing to hand in your project on time!
examples.zh: 你没能按时交项目，找的借口太让人失望了!

examples.en: The handle of the cup is broken.
examples.zh: 杯子的把手断了。

examples.en: The police found some handprints at the scene.
examples.zh: 警方在现场发现了一些手印。

meanings.meaning: 英俊的；漂亮的；美观的；悦目的

examples.en: He's the most handsome man I've ever met.
examples.zh: 他是我见过的最俊美的男子。

examples.en: The new building looks very handsome with its modern design.
examples.zh: 这座新建筑因其现代的设计看起来非常美观。

teaching_notes.content:
学生需要知道handsome, beautiful和pretty在表示“漂亮”时的区别：
handsome通常用于形容男性英俊、帅气，也可用来形容建筑、风景等事物美
观、大方。
beautiful常用于形容美丽的女性。
pretty常用于形容小巧可爱的事物。

examples.en: (hung/h?n/, hung)v.
examples.zh: 悬挂；把⋯⋯吊起

examples.en: He was the last man to be hanged for murder in this country.
examples.zh: 他是这个国家里最后一个因谋杀被处绞刑的人。

examples.en: The picture used to hang here and there are some marks on the wall.
examples.zh: 这幅画以前挂在这儿，墙上还有些痕迹呢。

examples.en: Teenagers like to hang out with their friends in the mall.
examples.zh: 青少年喜欢和朋友在商场闲逛。

teaching_notes.content:
hang out是口语化的短语，后接地点时需加介词in/at。
例如：We often hang out at the coffee shop near the school.
我们经常去学校附近的咖啡店。

examples.en: The fight happened so quickly that nobody could describe the start and the finish of it.
examples.zh: 这场打斗发生得太快，以至于没人能描述它是怎么开始和结束的。

examples.en: They happened to see the famous Chinese tennis player at the airport yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天碰巧在机场看到了那位著名的中国网球运动员。

teaching_notes.content:
happen是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记：happen = take place没有被动语态。
例如：Billy neither knows nor cares what happened.
比利既不知道也不关心发生了什么事。

examples.en: We happened to discover that we had a friend in common.
examples.zh: 我们碰巧发现我们有一个共同的朋友。

examples.en: An odd thing happened to him this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早晨遇到一件怪事。

examples.en: Mary and Peter are playing happily.
examples.zh: 玛丽和彼得快乐地玩耍着。

examples.en: I want to live happily.
examples.zh: 我想生活幸福。

examples.en: Diligence is the path leading to happiness.
examples.zh: 勤劳是获得幸福的途径。

usage_notes: —Happy birthday! Here is a present for you.
—Thank you!
——祝你生日快乐!这是送给你的礼物。
——谢谢!

examples.en: Every student in Grade Nine is studying hard to achieve more.
examples.zh: 为了获得更多的知识，九年级的每一位学生都在努力学习。

examples.en: It's hard to eat the hard bread.
examples.zh: 硬面包不好啃。

examples.en: Becoming a better person would not be hard if you follow all these instructions.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循这些指示，要成为一个更好的人是不难的。

examples.en: Linda, pass my glasses to me,please.I can hardly read the words in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 琳达，请把我的眼镜递给我。报纸上的字我几乎看不清。

examples.en: It hardly snows in Shanghai in winter, does it?
examples.zh: 上海的冬天几乎不下雪，是吗?

teaching_notes.content:
hardly是常考单词，常出现在反义疑问句中，所以学生一定要知道：
1)陈述部分含有hardly, never,none, seldom, rarely,little, few,no,neither,nobody,
no one,nothing,too...to.⋯.表示否定意义的词时，疑问部分要用肯定形式。
例如：The children seldom have any eggs for breakfast every morning, do they?
孩子们每天早餐几乎不吃鸡蛋，是吗?
2)陈述部分含有否定前、后缀构成的词时，作肯定句处理，疑问部分要用否定
形式。
例如：He failed/disliked/disagreed⋯,didn't he?
He is a man of few words,isn't he?他是个沉默寡言的人，不是吗?
He is told not to ..., isn't he?他被告知不要⋯⋯,不是吗?
He is unhappy/dishonest,isn't he?他不高兴/不诚实，不是吗?
3)当陈述部分是I think, I believe, I guess 等主句后跟 that从句时(当主句的主语
是第一人称),疑问部分应该与从句保持一致，并且要注意否定的转移。
例如：I believe he will pass the exam,won'the?
我相信他会通过考试，不是吗?
I don't think he will pass the exam, will he?
我不认为他会通过考试，是吗?

examples.en: The Chinese nation is hardworking and brave.
examples.zh: 中华民族是勤劳勇敢的。

examples.en: Don't harm your eyes by reading in dim light.
examples.zh: 不要在昏暗的灯光下看书，以免损伤眼睛。

examples.en: It wouldn't do any harm to ask for advice.
examples.zh: 向别人征询建议是不会有任何害处的。3词形拓展

examples.en: harmful adj.
examples.zh: 有害的；导致损害的

examples.en: harmless adj.
examples.zh: 无害的

examples.en: The organisation has set strict rules on the release of harmful chemicals.
examples.zh: 该组织对有害化学品的排放制定了严格的规定。

examples.en: We should live in harmony with allliving things on the earth.
examples.zh: 我们应该和地球上的所有生物和谐共处。

examples.en: The farmers are very happy with the good harvest this year.
examples.zh: 农民们因今年的好收成特别高兴。

examples.en: The red hat is too small to wear.
examples.zh: 这顶红帽子太小了，不能戴。

examples.en: I hate to see posers showing off.
examples.zh: 我最恨看装腔作势的人一副卖弄的样子。

examples.en: Dad sometimes goes to the supermarket with us though he hates going shopping.
examples.zh: 爸爸虽然讨厌购物，但有时会和我们一起去超市。

examples.en: I was seventeen and filled with a lot of hate.
examples.zh: 我那时17岁，满腔仇恨。

examples.en: I have something important to discuss with Tim.I will wait for Tim until he gets back.
examples.zh: 我有一些重要的事情要与蒂姆讨论。我会一直等到他回来。

examples.en: Could you tell me when we will have a meeting?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我，我们什么时候开会吗?

examples.en: She had a fever last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚发烧了。

teaching_notes.content:
have是常考使役动词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
have sb. do sth.使某人做某事
have sth. done=ask sb. to do sth.请某人做某事

examples.en: You've got to come.
examples.zh: 你必须来。

examples.en: We have a lot in common, such as our hobbies.
examples.zh: 我们有很多共同之处，比如我们的爱好。

examples.en: I’m afraid I must be going now. I have a class at ten.
examples.zh: 我想我现在得走了。我10点有课。

examples.en: You have eight lessons every day, don't you?
examples.zh: 你每天有8节课，不是吗?

meanings.meaning: 玩得很愉快；过得很愉快

examples.en: We had a very good time at the evening party.
examples.zh: 我们在晚会上玩得很愉快。

teaching_notes.content:
have a good time是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习
中，所以学生一定要知道：have a good time与enjoy oneself意思相同，在句中
可以互换。
例如：I hope you'll have a good time during your stay in Paris next month.
=I hope you'll enjoy yourself/yourselves during your stay in Paris next month.
我希望你/你们下个月在巴黎期间能度过一个美好时光。

examples.en: Peter doesn't have breakfast at school every day.
examples.zh: 彼得不是每天都在学校用早餐的。

examples.en: I have no idea what to do.
examples.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

teaching_notes.content:
have no idea是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：have no idea与don't know意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: I always have pity on the beggars.
examples.zh: 我总是对乞丐心怀怜悯。

examples.en: Does he have sports every day?
examples.zh: 他每天运动吗?

examples.en: He is a student.
examples.zh: 他是一名学生。

examples.en: We've never seen a more amazing creature. It has no head but is alive.
examples.zh: 我们从没见过比这更令人惊异的生物。它没有头，但是活的。

examples.en: I have a terrible headache.
examples.zh: 我头痛得厉害。

examples.en: The headline is important.
examples.zh: 大标题很重要。

examples.en: The headmaster gave a wonderful speech despite the rain.
examples.zh: 校长冒雨发表了一场精彩的演讲。

meanings.meaning: (尤指带麦克风的)头戴式受话器，耳机

examples.en: He wears a headset to listen to music.
examples.zh: 他戴着耳机听音乐。

examples.en: Smoking is harmful to our health.
examples.zh: 吸烟有害健康。

examples.en: The government is trying to improve the health care system.
examples.zh: 政府正在努力改善医疗服务体系。

examples.en: Healthy eating and doing exercise every day can keep us fit.
examples.zh: 健康饮食和每天运动能让我们保持健康。

examples.en: Can you speak louder,please? I can't hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 你可以大声一点吗?我听不清楚。—Billy lost his bike yesterday and had to walk home.—Oh,I’m sorry to hear that.——昨天比利的自行车丢了，他只好步行回家。——哦，听到这个消息我很抱歉。

examples.en: We heard two people arguing when we walked past that area.
examples.zh: 当我们走过那个地方的时候，听到两人正在争论。

teaching_notes.content:
hear是常考感官动词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
1) hear sb.doing sth.指动作正在进行当中。
例如：I hear him talking next door.我听到他正在隔壁房间讲话。
2) hear sb.do sth.指动作已发生，完成了，也就是说听到整个过程。意思是“听
到某人做了某事”,动作不再呈现。
例如：Would you ask her to sing a song for us? We'd like to hear her sing like a sporano.
你能让她为我们唱一首歌吗?我们喜欢听她像女高音那样唱。
3)大多数的感官动作(see, watch, notice等)都可以用于这两种结构，但要注意加
以区别。用v-ing,表示动作正在进行，即处于发生的过程中，还没有结束；
用不定式则表示全过程，或经常性的动作，或过去的动作。
试比较：Do you hear someone knocking at the door?(讲时还在敲)
I heard someone knock at the door three times.(讲时敲的动作已结束)

examples.en: I hear from her every week.
examples.zh: 我每星期都能收到她的来信。

teaching_notes.content:
hear from是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：hear from sb.与receive a letter from sb.意思相同，在句中可
以互换。

examples.en: I heard of his death last week.
examples.zh: 我上周听说了他的死讯。

examples.en: I will remember you in my heart.
examples.zh: 我将把你记在心中。

examples.en: The sun gives off heat.
examples.zh: 太阳散发出热量。

examples.en: The stove heats the room.
examples.zh: 暖炉使房间暖和起来。

examples.en: We use a heater to keep warm in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天我们用加热器取暖。

examples.en: The heating in our house doesn't work well.
examples.zh: 我们家的暖气设备不太好用。

examples.en: The city was hit by a severe heatwave last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，这座城市遭受了严重的热浪袭击。

examples.en: The gentleman lost his temper for the first time and shut the door heavily when he left.
examples.zh: 这位绅士第一次发了脾气。他离开时重重地关上了门。

examples.en: How heavy is that typewriter?=What is the typewriter's weight?
examples.zh: 那台打字机有多重?

examples.en: Jim is of average height in our class, but he is still taller than Tommy.
examples.zh: 吉姆在我们班身高中等，但他仍比汤米高。

examples.en: Hello,how are you?
examples.zh: 喂，你好吗?

examples.en: You should wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
examples.zh: 你骑自行车时应该戴头盔。

examples.en: Can you help me to get some help?
examples.zh: 你能帮我找人帮个忙吗?

examples.en: Professor Wang personally thanked everyone who helped with the project.
examples.zh: 王教授亲自向所有为这个项目提供过帮助的人表示了感谢。

examples.en: The students have recently finished their group project with the teacher's help.
examples.zh: 在老师的帮助下，同学们最近完成了他们的小组课题。

examples.en: Jane will help me with the maths problem.
examples.zh: 简将帮助我做数学题。

examples.en: But have you ever heard of a forest fire that can be helpful for a forest?
examples.zh: 但你有没有听说过森林火灾有助于森林生态的发展呢?

examples.en: The Greeks were glad to find the wooden horse was helpful in capturing the city.
examples.zh: 希腊人很高兴地发现这匹木马对攻占这座城市很有帮助。

examples.en: The mother felt so helpless when she knew her child was seriously ill.
examples.zh: 当这位母亲得知自己的孩子病得很重时，她感到非常无助。

examples.en: My hens are laying well.
examples.zh: 我养的鸡下蛋下得多。

examples.en: I gave her a book.
examples.zh: 我给了她一本书。

examples.en: It's not her fault.
examples.zh: 这不是她的错。

examples.en: Many herbs are used in cooking to add flavour.
examples.zh: 许多香草被用于烹饪以增添风味。

examples.en: The shepherd is herding the sheep.
examples.zh: 牧羊人在放羊。

examples.en: I was born here. I'm quite familiar with the streets in this town.
examples.zh: 我出生在这里。我对这个小镇的街道相当熟悉。

examples.en: We went here and there looking for berries.
examples.zh: 我们四处寻找浆果。

teaching_notes.content:
here and there是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：here and there与 everywhere意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.
examples.zh: 虽然他们真的很伟大，但他们从来没有认为自己是英雄。

examples.en: My dog is well-trained, but hers is still learning basic commands.
examples.zh: 我的狗训练有素，但她的狗还在学习基本指令。

meanings.meaning: (用作女性的反身代词)她自己；自己

examples.en: She did it herself.
examples.zh: 她自己做的这件事。

examples.en: I’m still hesitating.
examples.zh: 我仍然在犹豫。

examples.en: "Hi,Liz,"she said shyly.“
examples.zh: 你好，利兹，”她腼腆地说。

examples.en: When we visit some websites,hidden software may collect our personal information.
examples.zh: 当我们访问一些网站时，隐藏软件可能会收集我们的个人信息。

examples.en: The boy hid in the tree.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩躲在树里。

examples.en: Nowadays the oil price in the world is getting much higher than before.
examples.zh: 如今世界上的石油价格比以前高得多。

examples.en: Shanghai Tower is one of the highest buildings in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 上海中心大厦是上海最高建筑物之一。

examples.en: The high-speed train is very fast.
examples.zh: 高速列车非常快。

examples.en: Early in the morning, hikers pack everything that they willneed for the day's hike.
examples.zh: 一大早，徒步旅行者们把当天旅行所需的一切都打包装好。

examples.en: We plan to hike the Samaria Gorge.
examples.zh: 我们计划去撒马利亚峡谷远足。

examples.en: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.
examples.zh: 我从车站跑上山顶，连气都喘不上来了。

examples.en: I gave him a present.
examples.zh: 我给了他一个礼物。

meanings.meaning: (用作男性的反身代词)他自己；自己

examples.en: He introduced himself.
examples.zh: 他作了自我介绍。

meanings.meaning: 他的；他的(所有物);属于他的

examples.en: This is his book.
examples.zh: 这是他的书。

teaching_notes.content:

一定要掌握how,what, where, why, which 等词的转换用法：
划线划在twice a year上，用How often提问
划线划在twice上，用How many times提问
划线划在for twenty minutes 上，用How long提问
划线划在until 8 o'clock 上，用How long提问
划线划在since 1918上，用How long提问
划线划在in 1918上，用When提问
划线划在 in twenty minutes上，用How soon提问
划线划在at 7 o'clock上，用What time提问
划线划在fifty miles an hour上，用How fast提问
划线划在fifty minutes'walk 上，用How far 提问
划线划在English 上，用What language提问
划线划在English or Chinese上，用Which language提问
划线划在 to do 上表示目的，用Why或What...for提问
划线划在on the tenth floor上，用Where或Which floor do you live on?或On which
floor提问
划线划在5 dollars上，用How much i ...?/How much does ...cost?/What's the price
of..?句型提问

农民用火来清理田地以便他们能种植农作物。
Grandma opened the window in order to breathe the fresh air.
=Grandma opened the window so that she could breathe the fresh air.
为了呼吸新鲜的空气，奶奶打开了窗户。
Bob made up his mind to study English hard in order to find a good job.
=Bob made up his mind to study English hard so that he could find a good job.
为了能找到一份好工作，鲍勃决心努力学习英语。

examples.en: He became,in other words, a great hero.
examples.zh: 换句话说，他成了一位伟大的英雄。

examples.en: You should go to the office and talk to the manager in person.
examples.zh: 你应该去办公室亲自和经理谈谈。

examples.en: What did you give him in return?
examples.zh: 你给他什么作为报答呢?

examples.en: In short,we need to take action to protect the environment right now.
examples.zh: 总之，我们现在就应该采取行动保护环境。

examples.en: Are you surprised when someone looks at you in surprise?
examples.zh: 当有人惊异地看着你时，你感到惊讶吗?

examples.en: In the end,Tom successfully fixed his bicycle without the help of his father.
examples.zh: 最后，汤姆没靠爸爸帮忙，成功修好了他的自行车。

teaching_notes.content:
in the end是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：in the end与at last或 finally意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: He does not know what will happen in the future.
examples.zh: 他不知道将来会发生什么事。

examples.en: He positioned the lamp in the middle of the table.
examples.zh: 他把灯放在桌子中间。

examples.en: What makes him behave in this way?

examples.en: You must hurry up or you cannot finish it in time.
examples.zh: 你必须抓紧些，否则你来不及完成。

examples.zh: 这个年轻警察在老人有困难时总会帮助他们。

examples.en: The traditional breakfast in this area includes bread, cakes and eggs.

examples.zh: ￥330,000.她年收入33万人民币。

examples.en: Your answer is incorrect.
examples.zh: 你的答案不准确。

examples.en: He is indeed a good student.
examples.zh: 他确实是个好学生。

examples.en: My little brother is learning to be independent by cleaning his room on his own.
examples.zh: 我的小弟弟正通过自己打扫房间，学着变得独立。

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的个人想法。

examples.zh: 个人的权利受到法律保护。

examples.en: I like indoor activities.
examples.zh: 我喜欢室内运动。

examples.en: It's too cold outside,so we stay indoors and watch TV.
examples.zh: 外面太冷了，所以我们待在室内看电视。

examples.zh: 我们的产业正在发展壮大。

examples.en: You can buy some inexpensive souvenirs at this local market.
examples.zh: 你可以在这个当地市场买到一些便宜的纪念品。

meanings.meaning: 影响；作用；影响力；支配力
影响；左右；对⋯⋯起作用；支配

examples.en: Van Gogh had a major influence on the development of modern painting.
examples.zh: 梵高对现代绘画的发展有着重大影响。

examples.zh: 我们成了最好的朋友，他深深地影响了我。

examples.zh: 她是一位拥有数百万粉丝的网红博主。

meanings.meaning: 信息；消息；情报；资料；资讯

examples.en: It is impossible for us to memorise so much information by just reading once.
examples.zh: 要记住这么多的信息，只读一次对我们来说是不可能的。

examples.en: Flour is a main ingredient in making bread.
examples.zh: 面粉是制作面包的主要原料。

examples.en: The man injured his brain and couldn't remember anything for a long time.
examples.zh: 这名男子脑部受伤，很长一段时间里什么都记不起来了。

examples.en: The nurse in the rescue team treated the injured boy with great patience and care.
examples.zh: 救援队的护士以极大的耐心与关怀照料着受伤的男孩。

examples.en: He suffered a serious injury in the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 他在运动会中受了重伤。

examples.en: Don't write your exercise in red ink.
examples.zh: 不要用红墨水做练习。

examples.en: Do you know a spider eats about 2,000 insects a year?
examples.zh: 你知道一只蜘蛛一年大约吃掉2000只昆虫吗?

examples.en: The mouse is inside the box.
examples.zh: 老鼠在盒子中。

examples.en: Do you mind turning on the electric fan?It is a bit hot inside.
examples.zh: 你介意打开电风扇吗?里面有一点热。

examples.en: You can have pizza for dinner,or you can try the noodles instead.
examples.zh: 你晚餐可以吃比萨饼，或者可以试试面条。

examples.en: Instead of going further, the tourists took a rest in the hotel nearby.
examples.zh: 游客没有走得更远，就在附近的酒店休息了。

examples.en: Lin Dong should learn to solve problems by himself instead of asking others.
examples.zh: 林东应该学会独自解决问题，而不是求助别人。

meanings.meaning: 用法说明；命令，指令；指示；指导

examples.en: Follow the safety instructions, or you could end up in a dangerous situation.
examples.zh: 遵循安全指示，否则你可能会陷入危险境地。

examples.en: He is playing a musical instrument.
examples.zh: 他在演奏乐器。

examples.zh: 最终，他对学习日语失去了兴趣。

examples.en: I’m interested in playing basketball.
examples.zh: 我的爱好是打篮球。

examples.en: What an interesting story!
examples.zh: 多有趣的故事啊!

examples.en: Pudong International Airport is one of the biggest airports in the world.
examples.zh: 浦东国际机场是世界上最大的机场之一。

examples.en: Please show me how to use WeChat to talk with each other on the internet.
examples.zh: 请告诉我如何使用微信在网上互相交谈。

examples.en: Then you will possibly understand your questions better and get right answers on the day of the interview.
examples.zh: 这样你可能在面试那天更好地理解问题并正确回答。

examples.en: I'l interview you about your research work.
examples.zh: 我将就您的研究工作采访您。

meanings.meaning: 到⋯⋯里；向内；(表示状态的变化)变成；进入

examples.en: It turned into ice.
examples.zh: 它变成了冰。

examples.en: Could you introduce three historical events in the Tang dynasty to us?
examples.zh: 你能向我们介绍唐朝的3个历史事件吗?

examples.en: Since the new rules were introduced, many complaints have been made.
examples.zh: 自从新规出台以来，已经出现了诸多投诉。

examples.en: Edison invented quite a lot of things during his life.
examples.zh: 爱迪生在他一生中发明了很多东西。

examples.en: Making paper is one of the greatest inventions of ancient Chinese people.
examples.zh: 造纸是中国古代人民最伟大的发明之一。

examples.en: The internet is a great invention. It makes the world“smaller”.
examples.zh: 互联网是一项伟大的发明。它使世界变“小”了。

examples.en: The machine is named after its inventor.
examples.zh: 这台机器是以其发明者的名字命名的。

examples.en: The police took the case seriously and began investigating immediately.
examples.zh: 警方严肃对待这个案件，并立即展开了调查。

examples.en: We received Peter's invitation and went to his birthday party happily.
examples.zh: 我们收到了彼得的邀请，并愉快地参加他的生日聚会。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your invitation.
examples.zh: 非常感谢你的邀请。5词形拓展

examples.en: invite v.
examples.zh: 邀请

examples.en: The young artist often invites children to join his art activities, helping them develop an interest in painting.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的艺术家经常邀请孩子们参与他的艺术活动，助力他们培养绘画兴趣。

examples.en: Iron and wood have different natures.
examples.zh: 铁和木头的性质不同。

examples.en: Taiwan is the biggest island of China. I hope to visit it soon.
examples.zh: 台湾是中国最大的岛屿。我希望不久能参观这座岛。

examples.en: It is a cat.
examples.zh: 它是一只猫。

examples.en: I can't find my passport. Did you see it?
examples.zh: 我找不到护照了，你看见它了吗?

meanings.meaning: 项目；节目；一件商品(物品);一则

examples.en: I think we ought to pass on to the next item.
examples.zh: 我想我们应该接着开始下一个项目。

examples.en: This is its tail.
examples.zh: 这是它的尾巴。

examples.en: I'd like to buy that jacket, but the colour is not my first choice.
examples.zh: 我想买那件夹克，但颜色不是我的首选。

examples.en: I like to eat jam.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃果酱。

examples.en: I’m sure there will be fewer traffic jams in the future.
examples.zh: 我确信未来交通堵塞的情况会越来越少。

examples.en: The jasmine in the garden is in full bloom,filling the air with a sweet fragrance.
examples.zh: 花园里的茉莉盛开了，空气中弥漫着甜甜的香气。

examples.en: I don't want to buy the jeans because neither the colour nor the size fits me.
examples.zh: 我不想买那条牛仔裤，因为颜色和尺码都不适合我。

examples.en: I like to eat jelly very much.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢吃果冻。

examples.en: Her mother gave her a piece of jewellery on her birthday.
examples.zh: 她妈妈在她生日时送了她一件珠宝。

examples.en: The local government is planning to create more jobs for young people.
examples.zh: 当地政府正计划为年轻人创造更多的就业机会。

teaching_notes.content:
job是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与work的用法区别：
在作名词，表示“一件工作”时，job是可数名词，而work是不可数名词。
例如：He got a job as a waiter.他找到一份服务员的工作。
Cooking is not an easy job.做饭不是一件容易的事。
My brother is looking for work.我的哥哥正在找工作。
Our teacher gave us a lot of work to do today.
老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

examples.en: I got up early the next morning to jog.
examples.zh: 第二天早晨我一大早起来去慢跑。

examples.en: It must be fantastic if more students join in the charity show tomorrow.
examples.zh: 要是有更多的学生参加明天的慈善演出，那一定很棒。

teaching_notes.content:
join是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法。join与attend, enter
for, join in, take part in都有“参加”的意思，学生需知道它们的用法区别：
join指加入某个组织、团体，并成为其中一员，也可用于表示加入某人做某事。
例如：She joined the club two years ago.她两年前加入了这个俱乐部。
Will you join us for dinner?你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗?
attend常用于表示参加会议、婚礼、讲座、课程等较为正式的活动，强调出席
这一动作。
例如：He will attend an important meeting tomorrow.他明天将参加一个重要会议。
enter for主要用于表示报名参加竞赛、考试等活动。
例如：Visitors can enter for a guided tour of the museum.
游客可以报名参加博物馆的导览活动。
join in 更强调加入到他人正在进行的活动中，通常指小规模的活动，可与 take
part in互换。
例如：Can I join in the game?我能加入这个游戏吗?
take part in侧重于参加活动并在其中发挥作用、承担角色，通常用于参加会议、
比赛、活动等。
例如：They will take part in the volunteer activities this weekend.
他们将参加本周末的志愿者活动。

examples.en: We had better treat it as a joke.
examples.zh: 我们最好把它当作玩笑。

examples.en: I like to joke.
examples.zh: 我喜欢开玩笑。

examples.en: I want to be a journalist after graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业后我想当记者。

examples.en: Do you know if they had a good journey home?
examples.zh: 你知道他们回家的旅途是否愉快?

meanings.meaning: 欢乐；高兴；乐趣；愉快；喜悦

examples.en: To my great joy,my lost watch was found.
examples.zh: 使我极为高兴的是，我丢失的手表找到了。胺常用词组

examples.en: to one's joy
examples.zh: 使某人高兴的是

examples.en: jump for joy
examples.zh: 欢呼雀跃

proverbs.text: Judge not of men and things at first sight.

examples.en: The judge sentenced the bad egg to death.
examples.zh: 法官判这个混蛋死刑。

examples.en: Teachers always judge their students on the final examination.
examples.zh: 老师常根据期末考试来评价他们的学生。

usage_notes: —Let's go to get a pizza and a glass of orange juice.
—Good idea.
——我们去买一个比萨饼和一杯橙汁吧。
——好主意。

examples.en: His jump shot is very accurate.
examples.zh: 他的跳投非常精准。

examples.en: Don't jump to a conclusion! Let's discuss the problem first
examples.zh: 不要妄下结论!让我们先讨论这个问题。

examples.en: When she heard the good news,she jumped for joy.
examples.zh: 听到这个好消息时，她欢呼雀跃。

examples.en: The experienced detective never jumps to a conclusion when dealing with a new case.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的侦探处理新案件时从不草率下结论。

meanings.meaning: 年少者；较年幼者；年资较浅者

examples.en: Many Junior Three students give up their hobbies because of their busy school work.
examples.zh: 许多初三学生放弃自己的兴趣爱好，因为他们忙于学校作业。

examples.en: The junior in the office was responsible for organising the team-building event.
examples.zh: 办公室里的年轻员工负责组织团建活动。

examples.en: Just then a friend drove up and gave me a ride.
examples.zh: 正在那时，一个朋友开车过来，让我搭了他的车。

examples.en: Oh,my goodness. I left my dictionary in the reading-room just now.
examples.zh: 啊，天哪!我刚才把词典忘在阅览室里了。

teaching_notes.content:
just now是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：just now与a moment ago意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: Kangaroos are unique animals with strong hind legs and long tails.
examples.zh: 袋鼠是独特的动物，有着强壮的后腿和长长的尾巴。

examples.en: About one-third of the students in our class are keen on pop songs.
examples.zh: 我们班大约有三分之一的学生热衷于流行歌曲。

meanings.meaning: 保持；保存；继续不断；培育，饲养

proverbs.text: Keeping is harder than winning.

examples.en: Amazing new products are developed constantly to keep customers excited.
examples.zh: 令人惊叹的新产品不断研发出来，让顾客保持兴奋。

examples.en: You are lucky enough to keep the book for a week.
examples.zh: 你够幸运，这本书你可以借一周。

examples.en: The poor baby has kept crying for a long time because he can't find his mother.
examples.zh: 可怜的宝宝一直哭了很久，因为他找不到他的母亲。

examples.en: Keeping pet dogs can help people learn more about life and death.
examples.zh: 养宠物狗可以帮助人们更了解生命和死亡。

teaching_notes.content:
keep 主要有以下三种用法：
1)keep sth.+形容词使某物保持某种状态
2)keep a dog(=raise a dog)养一只狗
3)keep doing sth.继续做某事
keep作为常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型或词语转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：keep doing与go on doing/didn't stop doing意思相同，在
句中可以互换。
例如：Jimmy kept talking with others in the Maths lesson yesterday.
=Jimmy went on/didn't stop talking with others in the Maths lesson yesterday.
在昨天的数学课上，吉米一直在与他人讲话。

examples.en: I want to keep a diary, but I can't.
examples.zh: 我想记日记，可我做不到。

examples.en: Please keep an eye on my bag while I'm away.
examples.zh: 我离开时请帮忙照看一下我的包。

examples.en: The machine kept running.
examples.zh: 机器一直在运转。

teaching_notes.content:
keep doing sth.是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习
中，所以学生一定要知道：keep doing sth.与go on doing sth.意思相同，在句中
可以互换。

examples.en: I practise yoga to keep fit.
examples.zh: 我练瑜珈来保持健康。

examples.en: How does Jack keep in touch with his friends in America every week?
examples.zh: 杰克每周是如何与美国朋友保持联系的?

examples.en: The policeman told the boys to keep off the grass.
examples.zh: 警察告诉男孩们勿踩草地。

examples.en: If you won't keep quiet, you can get out!
examples.zh: 如果你不保持安静，那就只好请你出去了!

examples.en: That job willkeep you busy for a long time.
examples.zh: 那项工作会使你忙碌很长时间。

examples.en: We should keep track of our expenses.
examples.zh: 我们应该追踪我们的开支。

examples.en: I don't want to keep you from your work.
examples.zh: 我不想耽误你的工作。

teaching_notes.content:
keep⋯ from是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：keep..from与prevent ...from或stop.⋯. from意思相同，
在句中可以互换。
例如：Sometimes pet dogs bark at night and this keeps/prevents their neighbours from
sleeping.
=Sometimes pet dogs bark at night and this stops their neighbours from sleeping.
有时宠物狗夜间吠叫，这让他们的邻居睡不好觉。

examples.en: I searched every corner of the house for the key,but couldn't find it.
examples.zh: 我找遍了房子的每一个角落，却还是没找到那把钥匙。

teaching_notes.content:
key是常考单词，key 后常用介词 to表示用途。例如：
the key to success 成功的关键
key to the door房门钥匙
the key to the question 答案要点

examples.en: The keyboard is used to put information into the computer.
examples.zh: 键盘用于把信息输入电脑。

examples.en: In winter, Chinese students like to kick the Jianzi to keep themselves warm.
examples.zh: 在冬天，中国学生喜欢踢毽子取暖。

examples.en: It's a corner kick.
examples.zh: 这是一个角球。

examples.en: I am kidding.
examples.zh: 我在开玩笑。

examples.en: I don't go out much, mainly because I have to look after the kids.
examples.zh: 我不太出去，主要是因为我要照顾孩子。

examples.en: Tornadoes swept across the South America last month. At least 28 people were killed.
examples.zh: 上个月龙卷风横扫南美洲，至少有28人死亡。

examples.en: Apples cost eighteen yuan a kilogram.
examples.zh: 苹果每公斤18元。

examples.en: My home is half a kilometre away from here.
examples.zh: 我家离这儿有半公里。

examples.en: Most tomatoes are red when ripe, but some kinds are yellow.
examples.zh: 大多数西红柿成熟时是红色的，但有些品种是黄色的。

examples.en: It's very kind of you to help me with my English.
examples.zh: 你真好，帮我学英语。

examples.en: Most girls in our kindergarten like to play with dolls.
examples.zh: 我们幼儿园大多数女孩子喜欢玩洋娃娃。

examples.en: Your smile is the best way to show people your kindness.
examples.zh: 你的微笑是向人们展示你善意的最好方式。

examples.en: The story goes that long ago there lived a king.
examples.zh: 传说很久以前那儿有个国王。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, the princess lived in a beautiful kingdom.
examples.zh: 在童话故事里，公主生活在一个美丽的王国里。

examples.en: He tried to kiss her but she pushed him away.
examples.zh: 他想吻她，但她把他推开了。

examples.en: Come here and give me a kiss!
examples.zh: 过来亲我一下!

examples.en: Billy, is your mother cooking meat in the kitchen? It smells so nice!

teaching_notes.content:
little是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较与 few的用法
区别：
1) few, a few用来修饰可数名词；little, a little用来修饰不可数名词。
2) a few,a little表示肯定意义；few, little 表示否定意义。
例如：I can speak a little English.我能讲一点英语。
He has made a few mistakes in the exam.他在考试中犯了一些错误。
There is little sugar left. I will go to the supermarket to buy some.
几乎没有糖了。我要去超市买一些。
Few people came to the meeting.几乎没人来参加会议。
3)在only和quite 后面要用a few或 a little,不能用few 或little。
例如：only a little water 只有一点点水
quite a few students不少学生
4)few和little可与very,so,too等词连用。
例如：very few非常少
so little 如此少

examples.zh: 在只剩下他一个人的时候，他并不感到孤独。

teaching_notes.content:
lonely是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与 alone的用法区别：
lonely是指人孤独，寂寞的意思，alone则表示单独，独自一人。
例如：She lives alone,but she doesn't feel lonely.她一个人住，但她不感到寂寞。

examples.en: We couldn't believe that it was her real hair because it was so long.
examples.zh: 我们简直不敢相信这是她自己的头发，因为它是那么长。

examples.en: She waited long for the bus to arrive.
examples.zh: 她等了很久才等来公交车。

proverbs.text: Look before you jump.

examples.en: Let's have a look!
examples.zh: 我们去看看!

examples.en: Look at the blackboard, please.
examples.zh: 请看黑板。

examples.en: She looks unhappy today, and she has been very quiet since this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天看起来闷闷不乐的，从早上起就一直很安静。

examples.en: As middle school students, we should know how to look after ourselves.
examples.zh: 作为中学生，我们应该知道如何照顾自己。

teaching_notes.content:
look after是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：look after与take care of意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：You'd better look after your younger brother,Tom.
=You'd better take care of your younger brother, Tom.
你最好照顾你的弟弟，汤姆。

examples.en: The pupils are all looking at the chart on the wall.
examples.zh: 学生都瞧着墙上的图表。

examples.en: Her sister wanted to further her study instead of looking for a job.
examples.zh: 她妹妹想要继续深造，而不是找工作。

examples.en: Little Adam is looking forward to meeting his friend next week.
examples.zh: 小亚当期待下周见到他的小伙伴。

teaching_notes.content:
look forward to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习
中，所以学生一定要知道：look forward to doing sth.与expect to do sth.意思相
同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: He looks like a scholar.
examples.zh: 他看上去像个学者。

examples.en: The police reminded the public to look out for pickpockets in crowded areas.
examples.zh: 警方提醒公众在拥挤区域要提防扒手。

teaching_notes.content:
look out是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要知道：look out与be careful意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: I like to look through magazines during my break.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在休息时间浏览杂志。

examples.en: You'd better not look up every new word in the dictionary because you can guess it from the context.
examples.zh: 你最好不要用词典去查每一个新词，因为你能从上下文中猜到它的意思。

examples.en: He had to look up to see the top of the skyscraper.
examples.zh: 他不得不抬头才能看到摩天大楼的顶部。

examples.en: The lorry is carrying a lot of goods.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车装载着许多货物。

examples.en: Four people were hurt in the car accident, but luckily no lives were lost.
examples.zh: 在车祸中有4人受伤，幸好无人丧生。

examples.en: John lost his new calculator on his way to school yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天约翰在去学校的路上弄丢了他的新计算器。

examples.en: He didn't want to lose his life in the battle field.
examples.zh: 他不想在战场上送命。

teaching_notes.content:
lose one's life是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：lose one's life与die意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: If you don't take the map with you, you may lose your way to Shanghai Museum.
examples.zh: =Take the map with you,and you can find the way to Shanghai Museum.如果不带上这张地图，你去上海博物馆可能会迷路。

examples.en: Father lost temper after he was told his daughter stole a mobile phone from her deskmate.
examples.zh: 父亲得知女儿偷了她同桌的手机后，大发脾气。

examples.en: Danny has decided to go on a diet because he wants to lose weight.
examples.zh: 丹尼决定节食，因为他想减肥。

examples.en: Loss of health is more serious than loss of wealth.
examples.zh: 健康的丧失比财富的损失更为严重。

meanings.meaning: 丢失的；迷路的；弄不懂的；困惑的

examples.en: When Andy was unhappy about his lost smartphone,his friend gave him a big hug.
examples.zh: 当安迪为丢失了智能手机而郁闷时，他的朋友给了他一个大大的拥抱。

examples.en: The intricate plot of the movie left many viewers feeling lost.
examples.zh: 这部电影错综复杂的情节让许多观众感到困惑。

examples.en: Lots of students went to the school hall to enjoy the wonderful paintings by Mr. Hu.
examples.zh: 很多学生前往学校礼堂来欣赏胡先生的精彩画作。

proverbs.text: Action speaks louder than words.

examples.en: The music is too loud.Could you turn it down,please?
examples.zh: 音乐声太大了。你可以开得轻一点吗?

examples.en: She spoke loud enough for everyone to hear.
examples.zh: 她大声讲话以便所有人都能听见。

examples.en: The baby cried loudly when he emptied his bottle.
examples.zh: 婴儿一喝完瓶里的东西就大哭起来。

examples.en: The door of parents'love for children will never be closed.
examples.zh: 父母对孩子永远敞开爱的大门。

examples.en: I love you, everyone.
examples.zh: 我爱你们每个人。

examples.en: She looks lovely in the pink dress!
examples.zh: 她穿粉红色连衣裙看起来很可爱!

examples.en: The children are looking happily at these lovely dogs.
examples.zh: 孩子们高兴地看着这些可爱的狗狗们。

examples.en: When prices are low,he buys in.
examples.zh: 价格便宜时他买进。

examples.en: This bird is flying quite low.
examples.zh: 这只鸟飞得相当低。

examples.en: We should use more low-energy appliances to save resources.
examples.zh: 我们应该使用更多低能耗的电器来节约资源。

examples.en: Please lower your voice.We are in the library.
examples.zh: 请你小声一点。我们在图书馆里。

examples.en: The lower branches of the tree were easier to reach for picking fruits.
examples.zh: 长在较低树枝上的果子更容易被摘到。

related_words.meaning: 幸运的；有好运的；运气好的

examples.en: I had the luck to get a ticket.
examples.zh: 我侥幸弄到了一张票。

examples.en: Luckily, the small ship came back safely after a big storm.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，一场大风暴后，小船安全回来了。

meanings.meaning: 幸运的；有好运的；运气好的

examples.en: With the help of the police,Tim was lucky enough to get back his lost bike.
examples.zh: 在警察的帮助下，蒂姆幸运地找回了丢失的自行车。

examples.en: Most Chinese people think that eight is a lucky number.
examples.zh: 大多数中国人认为8是一个幸运数字。

examples.en: I need a cart for my luggage.
examples.zh: 我需要一辆行李车来装行李。

examples.en: According to the lunar calendar, the Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
examples.zh: 根据农历，春节是中国最重要的传统节日。

examples.en: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.
examples.zh: 在午餐桌上，没人相信他的故事是真的。

examples.en: I love the lyrics of this song. They are so meaningful.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这首歌的歌词。它们非常有意义。

examples.en: The silk clothes can't be washed in the washing machine.
examples.zh: 丝绸衣服不可以用洗衣机洗。

examples.en: The noise will drive me mad.
examples.zh: 这噪音会使我发疯的。

examples.en: Would you please find me a seat,madam?
examples.zh: 女士，能请你给我找个座位吗?

examples.en: Look! There is a magazine on the teacher's desk. Is it yours?
examples.zh: 瞧!老师的办公桌上有一本杂志。是你的吗?

examples.en: The magician is going to perform magic at the party.
examples.zh: 这位魔术师将在晚会上表演魔术。

examples.en: As the sun set over the ocean, she captured the magic moment with her camera.
examples.zh: 当太阳在海上落下，她用相机捕捉到了这个神奇的时刻。

examples.en: The little girl had a magical experience in the fairy tale park.
examples.zh: 小女孩在童话公园有了一次神奇的经历。

examples.en: The magician performed some wonderful tricks.
examples.zh: 魔术师表演了一些精彩的魔术。

examples.en: A postman's job is to deliver mail.
examples.zh: 邮递员的工作就是送邮件。

examples.en: They asked her to mail him a letter.
examples.zh: 他们要她给他寄封信。

examples.en: The main idea of the paragraph usually appears in the first sentence of the paragraph.
examples.zh: 段落的主要意思通常出现在该段的第一句上。

teaching_notes.content:
main是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学
生一定要知道：main与 the most important意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The main report at the meeting is our headmaster's speech.
=The most important report at the meeting is our headmaster's speech.
会上最重要的报告是我们校长的讲话。

examples.en: The old man's money mainly comes from family business.
examples.zh: 这位老人的财产主要来自家族企业。

examples.en: The two major dancers are level with each other.
examples.zh: 两个主要舞蹈演员水平相当。

examples.en: Mathematics is my major.
examples.zh: 我的专业是数学。

phrases.meaning: 尽力做到；务请；确保；查明；确信

examples.en: Most passengers were talking happily with each other when the bus made a sudden stop.
examples.zh: 当大部分乘客正高兴地交谈时，汽车突然停了下来。

examples.en: Could you please make a plan for our class trip?
examples.zh: 你能为我们的班级旅行做一个计划吗?

examples.en: It has little effect on the study if you make the students write all the time.
examples.zh: 如果你让学生一直写，这对学习几乎是没有效果的。

teaching_notes.content:
make是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握使役动词make的习惯用法。
1)make sth. done使某物被做
例如：make my hair cut 让我的头发被剪掉(剪头发)
2)make sb./sth.+adj.使某人/某物处于某种状态
例如：They tried to make her happy,but in vain.
他们设法使她高兴，但那是徒劳的。
3)make sb. do sth.=sb.be made to do sth.使某人做某事
例如：The heavy snowstorm made the mountain climbers stop halfway.
=The mountain climbers were made to stop halfway by the heavy snowstorm.
暴风雪使登山者半途而废。

examples.en: You can make a decision right now.You can also think it over for a couple of days.
examples.zh: 你可以现在就做决定，也可以再考虑几天。

examples.en: They want to make a film in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 他们想在上海拍电影。

examples.en: Then we started to make a fire.
examples.zh: 然后我们开始生火。

examples.en: He makes a living by writing.
examples.zh: 他以写作为生。

teaching_notes.content:
make a living是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：make a living与earn money 意思相同，在句中可以互换。

examples.en: Tom's father looked angrily at Tom because he had made so many mistakes.
examples.zh: 父亲生气地看着汤姆，因为他犯了那么多错误。

examples.en: If you make a noise,you'll scare off the animals.
examples.zh: 如果你弄出声响就会把动物吓跑。

examples.en: Nobody likes to make friends with dishonest people.
examples.zh: 没有人喜欢与不诚实的人交朋友。

examples.en: We should not make fun of the weak.
examples.zh: 我们不应该取笑弱者。

examples.en: We begin to consistently make money.
examples.zh: 我们开始持续地盈利。

examples.en: It's nice of Andy to help me with my English and I've made some progress.
examples.zh: 安迪真好，他帮我学英语。我已经取得了一些进步。

meanings.meaning: 尽力做到；务请；确保；查明；确信

examples.en: Please make sure the door is securely locked before you go to bed.
examples.zh: 睡前请务必确认门已经牢牢地锁好。

examples.en: Does she make the bed in the morning?
examples.zh: 她早上整理床铺吗?

examples.en: They made up their minds to sell the house.
examples.zh: 他们决定把房子卖掉。

teaching_notes.content:
make up one's mind是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练
习中，所以学生一定要知道：make up one's mind与decide意思相同，在句中可
以互换。

examples.en: She spends a lot of time on her make-up.
examples.zh: 她花很多时间化妆。

examples.en: The school master is a male teacher.
examples.zh: 校长是位男老师。

examples.en: He was the only male in the dance class.
examples.zh: 他是舞蹈班里唯一的男性。

meanings.meaning: 商场；大型购物区，购物中心

examples.en: Many attended the opening of the new shopping mall.
examples.zh: 很多人参加了新购物中心的开业仪式。

proverbs.text: No man is born wise or learned.

examples.en: Look at the photo! The fifth man from the right is my class teacher.
examples.zh: 看照片!从右边起第五个男人是我的班主任。

meanings.meaning: 管理；经营；处理；设法对付，完成(困难的事);明智地使用

examples.en: I manage a team of six engineers.
examples.zh: 我管理一个由6位工程师组成的小组。

examples.en: With only a few minutes left, they managed to turn the game around.
examples.zh: 只剩几分钟了，他们成功扭转了比赛局势。

teaching_notes.content:
manage是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：manage to do与succeed in doing意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：We have managed to drag the fallen tree clear of the road.
=We have succeeded in dragging the fallen tree clear of the road.
我们已经成功地把那棵倒下的树拖离道路。

examples.en: If you don't like the products,feel free to make a complaint to the manager.
examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢这产品，请随时向经理投诉。

examples.en: Mankind has made remarkable progress in science and technology.
examples.zh: 人类在科学技术方面取得了显著的进步。

examples.en: People need to work things out in their own manner and in their own time.
examples.zh: 人们需要以自己的方式和时间来处理问题。

proverbs.text: Many hands make light work.

examples.en: I won't believe the five-year-old boy can read so many words until I have tested him myself.
examples.zh: 直到我亲自对他进行了测试，我才相信这个5岁的孩子会读这么多的单词。

examples.en: I asked my friends for suggestions,and many were very helpful.
examples.zh: 我向朋友们征求建议，很多建议都相当有帮助。

examples.en: Emma stopped the car and looked at the map.
examples.zh: 艾玛停下车，看了一下地图。

meanings.meaning: 标记，记号；符号；(考试等)分数
标明，作记号于；给⋯⋯打分数

examples.en: You willbe able to get good marks if you do some revision every day.
examples.zh: 如果你每天都复习一下，你可以获得好成绩。

examples.en: Please mark where you have some questions.
examples.zh: 在有问题的地方作个记号。

examples.en: Where is the nearest market?
examples.zh: 最近的集市在哪儿?

examples.en: Marry me.
examples.zh: 嫁给我吧。

examples.en: People wear masks to protect themselves from the smog.
examples.zh: 人们戴口罩来防止雾霾伤害自己。

examples.en: The dog saved its master's life.
examples.zh: 这条狗救了它主人的命。

examples.en: He has mastered several foreign languages.
examples.zh: 他精通好几门外语。

examples.en: No one can match him in singing.
examples.zh: 论唱歌谁也比不过他。

usage_notes: —Our class failed in the school’s footballmatch last week.
—What a pity!
——上周学校的足球比赛我们班输了。
——多可惜!

examples.en: He is my best mate at school.
examples.zh: 他是我在学校最好的伙伴。

examples.en: Jack measured the length of the table to calculate how much material would be needed.
examples.zh: 杰克测量了这张桌子的长度，以便计算所需材料的用量。

examples.en: Tim spoke so quietly that he was asked to repeat himself in the maths class.
examples.zh: 蒂姆说话太轻了，数学课上他被要求再说一遍。

usage_notes: 用)数学

meanings.meaning: 要紧事；麻烦事；事情；问题；物质

examples.en: It's a personal matter.
examples.zh: 这是件私事。

examples.en: No matter what they tell us, what we believe is true.
examples.zh: 无论他们告诉我们什么,我们坚信的是真理。

examples.en: Depend on your passion and it willguide you towards what truly matters in life.
examples.zh: 坚守你的热爱，它会指引你找到人生中真正重要的东西。

examples.en: You may lose your way if you walk alone in the mountains at night.
examples.zh: 如果晚上你独自一人在山里走，你可能会迷路。—May I park my car here for a while?—No,you mustn't. Do you see the sign“NO PARKING”?——我可以把车停在这里一会儿吗?——不，你不能。你看到“禁止停车”的标志吗?

teaching_notes.content:
may是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下用法区别：
1)may be v.可能是
must be v.一定是
can't be v.不可能是(否定猜测用 can't be;肯定猜测用may be和 must be;可
能性大用must be,可能性小用may be。)
maybe(=perhaps) adv.可能
2)may 引导的一般疑问句的否定回答要用mustn't,表示“不允许”“不准”“不
行”等意思。
例如：—May I take this dictionary out of the library?
—No,you mustn't.
——我可以把这本字典拿出图书馆吗?
——不，不行。

examples.en: It's clouding up. Maybe it'll rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 天阴起来了，今天下午也许有雨。

examples.en: He gave me a flower.
examples.zh: 他给了我一朵花。

examples.en: Linda often helps her parents with the housework after meals.
examples.zh: 琳达饭后经常帮助父母做家务。

examples.en: What do you mean?
examples.zh: 你什么意思?

examples.en: The little girls had locked themselves in upstairs because Mack had been mean to them.
examples.zh: 小姑娘们把自己锁在楼上，因为麦克对她们很刻薄。

examples.en: These words are empty of meaning.
examples.zh: 这些话毫无意义。

examples.en: This is a meaningful activity.
examples.zh: 这是一项有意义的活动。

examples.en: "Mr. Zhu, you'd better not eat too much meat. You are already overweight," said the doctor.
examples.zh: 医生说：“朱先生，您最好不要吃太多的肉。您已经超重了。”

examples.en: She won a silver medal in the high jump.
examples.zh: 她跳高得了银牌。

examples.en: He has been at the forefront of medical progress for years.
examples.zh: 多年来，他一直处于医学发展的最前沿。

proverbs.text: A good medicine tastes bitter.

examples.en: How often should you take the medicine?
examples.zh: 这药你应该多长时间服一次?

examples.en: A medium coffee please.
examples.zh: 请给我一杯中杯咖啡。

examples.en: Art serves as a powerful medium for expressing complex emotions and ideas.
examples.zh: 艺术是表达复杂情感和思想的强有力媒介。

meanings.meaning: 遇见，见到；会见；迎接；满足

examples.en: Guess who I met in Nanjing Road?
examples.zh: 你猜我在南京路遇见了谁?

examples.en: To meet the needs of people from different countries, that book was published in different languages.
examples.zh: 为了满足来自不同国家读者的需求，这本书用不同语种出版。

examples.en: The athletic meet attracted participants from all over the country.
examples.zh: 这次运动会吸引了全国各地的参赛者。

examples.en: The 8th School Sports Meeting was put off because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因下大雨，第8届校运动会推迟了。

examples.en: The meeting between the two leaders was highly anticipated by the media.
examples.zh: 两位领导人的会见备受媒体关注。

examples.en: The melody of this piece of music is very catchy.
examples.zh: 这首曲子的旋律非常朗朗上口。

examples.en: Watermelon is a kind of delicious melon.
examples.zh: 西瓜是一种美味的瓜。

examples.en: The ice will melt when the temperature rises.
examples.zh: 温度升高时，冰会融化。

examples.en: One member of the surgical team administers the checklist.
examples.zh: 外科小组的一名成员负责管理清单。

examples.en: All the beautiful memories came into my mind when I saw these pictures.
examples.zh: 当我看到这些图片时，所有美好的回忆都涌入我的脑海。

examples.en: Although Mr.Wang is quite old, he stillhas a good short-term memory.
examples.zh: 虽然王先生年纪很大了，但他仍然有很好的短期记忆力。

examples.en: She did not mention her mother's absence.
examples.zh: 她并没有说起她母亲不在场的事。

examples.en: Could you give us another menu?
examples.zh: 你可以再给我们一份菜单吗?

examples.en: The room was in a mess.
examples.zh: 这个房间杂乱不堪。

examples.en: If you cancel now,you'll mess up all my arrangements.
examples.zh: 如果你现在取消，就会打乱我所有的安排。

meanings.meaning: 出错；搞砸；(在某事上)处理不当

examples.en: He messed up the important meeting because of his carelessness.

那座城市的人口超过500万。

teaching_notes.content:
none是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握none的习惯用法，及比较与
neither和no one的用法区别。
none指三者及以上的人或物，表示“没有一个”的意思。另外，none后常接 of
短语，of后可接可数名词或代词；作主语时，谓语动词用单、复数形式皆可；
of后也可接不可数名词，这时谓语动词必须用单数形式。
neither指两者中“没有一个”。
no one=nobody,只指人，表示“没有人”,不能指物，后面不能接of构成的短
语。no one作主语时，谓语动词只能用单数形式。
例如：Sorry, but none of us speaks/speak English.
抱歉!我们中没有一个人会讲英语。
None of the money on the desk is mine.桌上的那些钱都不是我的。
There are many apples in the basket, but none of them are fresh.
篮子里有很多苹果，但没有一个是新鲜的。
There are two apples on the plate, but neither of them is fresh.
盘子里有两个苹果，但没有一个是新鲜的。
No one/Nobody likes a person with bad manners.
不讲礼貌的人没有人喜欢。
注意：
none用来回答How many ..或How much ...引起的问句以及含“any(one) of+
名词”构成的一般疑问句。
no one/nobody用来回答Who...引起的问句及含anyone/anybody的一般疑问句。
nothing用来回答What...引起的问句及含anything的一般疑问句。
例如：①—How much water is there in the bottle?
—None.
——瓶子里有多少水?
——一点儿也没了。
②—Did any one of the passengers get injured in the accident?
—No,none was injured.
——有乘客在这场意外中受伤吗?
——不，没人受伤。
③—Who will go to the party?
—No one/Nobody.
——谁会去派对?
——没人去。
④—Did anyone want to attend the meeting?
—No,no one/nobody wanted to.
——有谁想参加那场会议吗?
——不，没人想去。
⑤—What's in your hand?
—Nothing.
——你手里有什么?
——什么也没有。
⑥—Do you have anything else to say for yourself?
—No,nothing else.

teaching_notes.content:
not only...but also...用于连接两个并列的成分，可以是名词、动词、形
容词、副词等，强调递进关系，表示“不但⋯⋯而且⋯⋯”。当连接两个主语时，
谓语动词遵循就近原则，即与but also 后的主语在人称和数上保持一致。例如：
Not only you but also he enjoys hiking in the mountains.你和他都喜欢在山上徒步。

usage_notes: 区别：
nothing = not anything,意为“没有任何东西；什么也没有”,强调内容，只能
指物，泛指。
例如：He felt hungry, but he could find nothing to eat in the kitchen.
他饿了，但在厨房里他没有找到吃的东西。(泛指所有吃的东西，不是特
指某一种)
nothing的习惯用法有以下3点：
1)泛指物；2)谓语用单数；3)一般用来回答含anything的一般疑问句及what引
起的特殊问句。
例如：①—What is in the box?
— Nothing.
——那盒子里有什么?
——什么也没有。
②—Is there anything in the sky?
— Nothing.
——天空中有什么?
——什么也没有。
③—Can you see anything without glasses?
—Nothing.
——你不戴眼镜能看见什么吗?
——啥也看不见。
none= not any, not one,意为“一点也没有；一个也没有”,即数量概念。既可
指人，也可指物，代指上文提到的事物，含特指概念。
例如：He wants me to lend him some money, but I have none at hand.
他想要我借些钱给他，但我现在手头上一个子儿也没有。(特指前面提到
的钱)
They asked for nine books, but there is/are none in the library at present.
他们需要9本书，但目前图书馆一本都没有。(特指前面提到的书)
none的习惯用法有以下4点：
1)可与of连用；2)谓语动词用单或复数均可；3)具体指什么人或物；4)一般用
来回答How many+n.,How much+n.,及含any+n.的疑问句。
例如：①None of us have/has seen him.我们都没有见过他。
②—How many students are there in the room?
—None.
——房间里有多少学生?
——一个也没有。
③—How much money do you have on you?
—None.
——你带了多少钱?
——一分没带。
④—Is there any water in the thermos?
—None.
——暖水瓶里有水吗?
——没有。

快点，否则你会赶不上公共汽车的。

teaching_notes.content:
plenty of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所
以学生一定要掌握以下固定搭配的用法：
1)plenty of(很多),a lot of(lots of)(大量)后面可跟可数名词，也可跟不可数名词。
2) a little(一些),much(许多),a great(good) deal of(大量),a large amount of(大量)
后面跟不可数名词。
3) a few(一些),many(许多),a large number of(大量)后面跟可数名词。

prefer ...to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：prefer ..to与like... better than或would rather do than do
意思基本相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Tina preferred watching TV to reading comic books when she was young.
=Tina liked watching TV better than reading comic books when she was young.
=Tina would rather watch TV than read comic books when she was young.
蒂娜小时候宁愿看电视，也不愿看漫画书。
I prefer playing sports outdoors to watching TV at home.
=I like playing sports outdoors better than watching TV at home.
=I would rather play sports outdoors than watch TV at home.
我宁愿去做户外运动，也不愿在家看电视。
