examples.en: Are you going to race your horse at Newmarket next week?
examples.zh: 你准备让你的马参加下周在纽马克特的赛马会吗?

examples.en: Peter and Bill each say they came first in the race.
examples.zh: 彼得和比尔都说自己跑了第一。

examples.en: Father bought her a stereo radio.
examples.zh: 父亲给她买了台立体声收音机。

examples.en: The train is running on the rails.
examples.zh: 火车在铁轨上行驶。

examples.en: The railway is still under construction.
examples.zh: 这条铁路仍在建设之中。

examples.en: In fact, there isn't so much rain in the city as they think.
examples.zh: 事实上，这座城市不像他们想的那样有这么多的雨水。

examples.en: We will go to the Happy Valley tomorrow unless it rains.
examples.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们会去欢乐谷。

examples.en: We believe rainbows will appear after storms.
examples.zh: 我们相信风雨之后必有彩虹。

examples.en: Most tropical areas have rainy and dry seasons.
examples.zh: 大多数热带地区有雨季和旱季。

meanings.meaning: 举起，使升高，提升，增加；饲养，抚养；筹钱，筹集；提起

examples.en: The government plans to raise the living standard of citizens.
examples.zh: 政府计划提高市民的生活水平。

examples.en: It is not easy to raise three children on a small income.
examples.zh: 靠微薄的收入抚养三个孩子并不容易。

examples.en: The charity event successfully raised enough money to help the homeless.
examples.zh: 这场慈善活动成功筹集到了足够的资金来帮助无家可归的人。

examples.en: The government's decision on building a factory in the city centre has raised many questions among the local people.
examples.zh: 政府决定在城市中心建造一家工厂，这在当地人中已经引发了许多质疑。

teaching_notes.content:
raise是常考单词，所以学生一定要比较 raise与rise的用法区别：
raise是及物动词；rise是不及物动词。
例如：raise your hand举起你的手
He raised his hat to me yesterday.昨天他向我举帽致意。
The river rose two feet.河水上涨2英尺。
The sun rises in the east.太阳从东方升起。
He rose to answer the question.他站起来回答问题。

examples.en: He has made rapid progress in his studies.
examples.zh: 他在学业上有着迅速的进步。

examples.en: The city is developing rapidly in recent years.
examples.zh: 这座城市近年来发展得很迅速。

examples.en: Pandas are rare animals.
examples.zh: 熊猫是珍稀动物。

examples.en: People in western countries rarely talk loudly in public, do they?
examples.zh: 在西方国家，人们很少在公共场所大声说话，是吗?

examples.en: They have been friends for years and have rarely argued.
examples.zh: 他们成为朋友已经好几年了，很少发生争执。

examples.en: Teachers rate students'work.
examples.zh: 老师给学生的作品打分。

meanings.meaning: 相当，颇；宁可；反而；有点儿，稍微

examples.en: I'm feeling rather sleepy.
examples.zh: 我感到十分困倦。

examples.en: She was not angry, but rather disappointed by his actions.
examples.zh: 她没有生气，而是对他的举动很失望。

examples.en: I rather suspect that he is not telling the truth.
examples.zh: 我有点儿怀疑他没说实话。

examples.en: He chose to stay at home rather than go out with his friends.
examples.zh: 他选择待在家里，而不是和朋友出去。

teaching_notes.content:
rather than连接两个并列成分，后接动词常用原形。
例如：I prefer to read books rather than watch TV after dinner.
晚饭后我更喜欢看书，而不是看电视。

examples.en: My uncle will send me postcards and stamps after he reaches France.
examples.zh: 我的叔叔到达法国后，会给我寄一些明信片和邮票。

examples.en: He reached a high level of proficiency in playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他在演奏钢琴方面达到了高水平的熟练程度。

proverbs.text: Reading makes a full man.

examples.en: It's easy to memorise the words if we know how to read them correctly.
examples.zh: 如果我们知道如何正确地读出这些单词，就很容易记住它们了。

examples.en: Tommy asked me ifI was interested in reading science fiction.
examples.zh: 汤米问我是否对读科幻小说感兴趣。

examples.en: Jenny was reading the text of Lesson Three at 8:00 last night.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上8点珍妮正在读第3课的课文。

examples.en: He showed great readiness to help others.
examples.zh: 他表现得很乐于助人。

meanings.meaning: 准备好的；准备完毕的；乐于

examples.en: He is ready for the trip.
examples.zh: 他已准备好去旅行。

examples.en: The real value of the book lies in its wonderful characterisation.
examples.zh: 这本书真正的价值在于精彩的人物塑造。

examples.en: If you want to realize your dream, study hard from now on.
examples.zh: 如果你想实现自己的梦想，从现在开始就要努力学习。

examples.en: It's really impossible for a child of five to take care of himself.
examples.zh: 要5岁儿童自己照顾自己，这真的是不可能的。

examples.en: That is the reason why we must go now.
examples.zh: 那就是我们现在必须走的理由。

examples.en: The house was rebuilt after the fire.
examples.zh: 这房子是火灾后重建的。

proverbs.text: It is better to give than to receive.

examples.en: By the end of last month, Mrs. Lin had received many interesting comic strips created by the students.
examples.zh: 到上月底，林老师收到了许多由学生创作的有趣的漫画。

teaching_notes.content:
receive是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：receive one's letter与hear from sb.意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I received my aunt's letter the other day.
=I heard from my aunt the other day.
几天前我收到我阿姨的来信。

examples.en: There have been many changes in our school in recent years.
examples.zh: 近几年，我们学校发生了许多变化。

examples.en: Recently,we have all worked harder to improve ourselves in many ways.
examples.zh: 最近，我们所有人都更加努力，在各个方面提升自己。

examples.en: She found a new recipe for making cakes.
examples.zh: 她发现了一个做蛋糕的新方子。

examples.en: We need to recite some English passages.
examples.zh: 我们需要背诵一些英语短文。

examples.en: She had changed so much that I could hardly recognize her.
examples.zh: 她的变化这么大，我简直认不出来了。

examples.en: The teacher recommended some really worthwhile novels to his students.
examples.zh: 老师推荐给学生一些真正有价值的小说。

examples.en: On the ninth page of the guide,you'll find recommendations for best restaurants.
examples.zh: 在指南的第9页，你会找到最佳餐厅推荐。

examples.en: Several world records were broken by Bolt at the Olympics.
examples.zh: 博尔特在奥运会上打破了多项世界纪录。

examples.en: She has recorded some popular songs.
examples.zh: 她录了一些通俗歌曲。

examples.en: We should recycle garbage,not burn it.
examples.zh: 我们应该回收利用垃圾，而不是焚烧。

examples.en: He was wearing a white shirt and a red tie.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件白衬衫，系了一条红领带。

examples.en: I prefer red to blue.
examples.zh: 比起蓝色，我更喜欢红色。

examples.en: We have reduced the number of classes from eight to six.
examples.zh: 我们已将班级数量由8个减少到6个。

examples.en: We often refer to these books in our work.
examples.zh: 我们工作中经常参考这些书。

examples.en: The author does not give references.
examples.zh: 作者没有注明参考(所引资料的)出处。

examples.en: I don't know why he refused the job offer.
examples.zh: 我不明白他为什么拒绝那份工作。

examples.en: The proud lady refuses to accept any advice.
examples.zh: 这位高傲的女士拒绝接受任何建议。

phrases.meaning: 常用于信件结尾)致以亲切的问候

examples.en: Please give my regards to your parents when you see them.
examples.zh: 见到你父母时，请代我向他们问好。

examples.en: She looked back on the past without regret.
examples.zh: 她回首往事，毫无遗憾。

examples.en: If you don't take my advice,you'll regret it.
examples.zh: 你若不听我的劝告，你会后悔的。

examples.en: Regular exercise is an effective way to stay healthy and reduce stress.
examples.zh: 规律运动是保持健康、缓解压力的有效方法。

examples.en: The relation between the two countries is very important.
examples.zh: 两国之间的关系非常重要。

examples.en: She found it impossible to extricate herself from the relationship.
examples.zh: 她发现自己不可能从这种关系中解脱出来。

examples.en: Today we visited our relative.
examples.zh: 今天我们探望了我们的亲戚。

examples.en: Sam needs to relax,so he is looking forward to a holiday.
examples.zh: 萨姆需要放松，所以他期待着假期。

examples.en: She felt relaxed after listening to the soft music for a while.
examples.zh: 听了一会儿轻音乐后，她感觉很放松。

examples.en: It helps us release anxious thoughts.
examples.zh: 它能帮助我们释放焦虑情绪。

examples.en: The movie willbe on release from Christmas.
examples.zh: 影片将从圣诞节开始上映。

examples.en: You can always rely on Jim,he won't fail you.
examples.zh: 你可以永远依靠吉姆，他不会让你失望的。

examples.en: Being independent means believing in yourself without relying on others.
examples.zh: 独立意味着相信自己，不依赖他人。

meanings.meaning: 剩余，余留；保留，保持不变

examples.en: The temperatures remained below freezing all day.
examples.zh: 气温一整天都保持在冰点以下。

examples.en: Archaeologists are studying the remains of a Roman city.
examples.zh: 考古学家正在研究一座罗马城市的遗迹。

examples.en: The famous singer died, but her sweet voice will be remembered for ever.
examples.zh: 这位著名歌手去世了，但她甜美的声音将永远被铭记。

teaching_notes.content:
remember是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较 remember
doing与remember to do的用法区别：
1)remember doing 表示记得做过某事(已做)。
2) remember to do表示记住去做某件事(还没做)。
例如：I remembered turning off the lights when I left the room.
我记得我离开房间时把灯关了。
Please remember to close the door when you go to bed.
你去睡觉时，请记住把门关上。

examples.en: He reminded me that I ought to do it at once.
examples.zh: 他提醒我应该现在就去做这件事。

examples.en: The house is in need of repair.
examples.zh: 那幢房子需要整修。

examples.en: The students can not only operate the machines with safety but also repair them.
examples.zh: 学生们不仅能安全地操作这些机器，而且还能修理这些机器。

examples.en: Though I repeated the phone number many times, the foreigner still couldn't write it down.
examples.zh: 虽然我把电话号码重复了好多次，这个外国人还是不能把它写下来。

examples.en: He never replied to the letters.
examples.zh: 他从来都不回信。

examples.en: Silence is the best reply to calumniation.
examples.zh: 沉默是对诽谤的最有力回击。

meanings.meaning: 报道；报告；成绩单；(新闻)报道；调查报告

examples.en: She has given us a progress report on how the project is going.
examples.zh: 她给我们作了关于项目进程的报告。

examples.en: John reported the two robberies to the police just now.
examples.zh: 刚刚约翰向警方报告了这两起抢劫案。

examples.en: It is reported that two-thirds of the fruits in that supermarket are from Hainan Island.
examples.zh: 据说，该超市三分之二的水果来自海南岛。

examples.en: The reporter described the accident in detail.
examples.zh: 记者详尽地描述了那起意外事件。

examples.en: the People's Republic of China
examples.zh: 中华人民共和国

examples.en: I received a request from my boss to finish the report by tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我收到老板的要求，明天前完成这份报告。

examples.en: The customer requested a refund for the damaged product.
examples.zh: 顾客就损坏的商品要求退款。

related_words.meaning: 所需的东西；必备的条件

examples.en: All passengers are required to fasten their seat belts during takeoff.
examples.zh: 所有乘客在起飞时都被要求系好安全带。

examples.en: Learning a new language requires time and patience.
examples.zh: 学习一门新语言需要时间和耐心。

examples.en: The rescue of the lost hiker took three days in the mountain.
examples.zh: 在山里营救迷路的徒步旅行者花了3天时间。

examples.en: The firefighters rushed to rescue the people in the burning building.
examples.zh: 消防员赶赴现场营救着火大楼里的人。

examples.en: The historical background to the play has been very carefully and thoroughly researched.
examples.zh: 已对这个剧本的历史背景进行了细致全面的研究。

examples.en: The latest research shows that regular exercise can improve mental health.
examples.zh: 最新研究表明，定期锻炼可以改善心理健康。

examples.en: The researcher is working on a new project.
examples.zh: 这位研究者正在从事一个新项目。

examples.en: This country is rich in natural resources.
examples.zh: 该国自然资源丰富。

examples.en: I respect him for his diligence.
examples.zh: 我敬佩他的勤奋。

examples.en: The Double Ninth Festival reminds us to respect the elderly.
examples.zh: 重阳节提醒我们要尊重老人。

examples.en: He didn't respond to my question.
examples.zh: 他没有回答我的问题。

examples.en: She has received a response from that college to her application.
examples.zh: 她已经收到那所大学对她申请的答复。

related_words.meaning: 负责的；有责任的；可信任的

examples.en: We need to take responsibility for looking after our own health.
examples.zh: 我们必须对自己的健康负责。

meanings.meaning: 负责的；有责任的；可信任的

examples.en: Being responsible means taking ownership of your mistakes and learning from them.
examples.zh: 有责任感意味着要对自己的错误负责，并从中吸取教训。

meanings.meaning: 休息；休息时间；剩余部分；其余的人(物)

examples.en: The doctor advised him to take a rest for a few days.
examples.zh: 医生建议他休息几天。

examples.en: The rest of us were allowed to go home.
examples.zh: 我们中的其他人被允许回家。

examples.en: You need to rest from your labour. You look very tired.
examples.zh: 你看上去很疲劳，需要放下工作休息一下。

examples.en: I shall leave the restaurant unless the waiter comes soon.
examples.zh: =I shall leave the restaurant if the waiter doesn't come soon.除非服务员马上来，否则我就离开饭店。

examples.en: Remember,the harder you work, the more good results you will get.
examples.zh: 记住，你越努力工作，你越会得到好的结果。

examples.en: His carelessness resulted in the accident.
examples.zh: 他的粗心导致了这场事故。

examples.en: My grandfather will retire next year.
examples.zh: 我爷爷明年将退休。

examples.en: The famous athlete decided to retire from the sport.
examples.zh: 这位著名的运动员决定退役。

examples.en: The retired workers receive money from the government till they die.
examples.zh: 退休工人从政府那里领取养老金直到去世为止。

examples.en: He returned the books to the library yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天把书还给了图书馆。

examples.en: After some time, small plants begin to grow.Animals return soon after the plants return. This again makes an eco-system.
examples.zh: 过了一段时间之后，幼苗开始生长。万物复苏，动物也回来了。这又形成了一个生态系统。

examples.en: The return of warm weather signals the arrival of spring.
examples.zh: 温暖天气的回归预示着春天的到来。

teaching_notes.content:
return是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：return与come back意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The girl didn't fall asleep until her mother returned last night.
=The girl didn't fall asleep until her mother came back last night.
昨晚这个女孩一直没有睡着，直到她妈妈回来。

examples.en: Jerry's family has made the fifth day of each month their reunion day.
examples.zh: 杰瑞一家把每月的5号定为家庭团聚日。

meanings.meaning: 可重复使用的；可再次使用的

examples.en: We should use more reusable bags instead of plastic bags to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 我们应该多用可重复使用的袋子，而不是塑料袋，以保护环境。

related_words.meaning: 可重复使用的；可再次使用的

examples.en: The same water was reused after chemical treatment.
examples.zh: 原来的水经过化学处理之后被再度利用。

examples.en: The college published a drama review.
examples.zh: 学院出版了一份戏剧评论刊物。

examples.en: Have you reviewed what we covered in class yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天我们课堂上讲的东西你们复习了吗?

meanings.meaning: 奖励；奖赏；报酬；报答，回报

examples.en: He was given the job as a reward for running a successful leadership bid.
examples.zh: 因为成功组织了领导职位竞选活动，他得到了这份工作。

examples.en: Make the extra effort to impress the buyer and you willbe rewarded with a quicker sale.
examples.zh: 多用心去打动顾客，货物就会更快售出。

examples.en: The rhythm of this dance music is very strong.
examples.zh: 这首舞曲的节奏非常强烈。

examples.en: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.
examples.zh: 南方人比较喜欢吃米饭，北方人爱吃面食。

meanings.meaning: 富裕的，有钱的；味道浓的；重油的；丰富的

examples.en: Alot of people think that happiness is about being rich, but I disagree.
examples.zh: 很多人认为幸福就是富有，但我不同意。

examples.en: It's not easy to rid oneself of a habit.
examples.zh: 要改掉一个人的习惯是不容易的。

examples.en: Can you guess the riddle?
examples.zh: 你能猜出这个谜语吗?

meanings.meaning: 乘车旅行；(乘车或骑车的)短途旅程

examples.en: Now my father rides his bike to work every day instead of driving.
examples.zh: 现在我的父亲每天骑自行车去上班而不是开车去。

examples.en: Since it was raining heavily, John offered to give me a ride to work.
examples.zh: 由于下大雨，约翰主动提出载我去上班。

meanings.meaning: 对的，正确的；恰当的；右边的
正确地；恰恰；向右，在右边

examples.en: I'll try to do whatever is right.
examples.zh: 只要是正当的事，我都尽力去做。

examples.en: It's quite late. We'd better go home by taxi right now.
examples.zh: 太晚了，我们最好现在打车回家。

examples.en: It's on your right.
examples.zh: 它在你右边。

examples.en: Let's hurry up. The electric bellis ringing.
examples.zh: 我们快点。电铃响了。

examples.en: Her laughter rang out in the room.
examples.zh: 她的笑声在房间里回荡。

examples.en: I willgive you a ring tonight.
examples.zh: 今天晚上我给你打电话。

examples.en: The river is rising after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后河水涨了起来。

examples.en: Use of these chemicals may present a fire risk.
examples.zh: 使用这些化学品可能有失火的危险。

examples.en: Many miners risk their lives working in the mine every day.
examples.zh: 许多矿工每天冒着生命危险在矿井工作。

examples.en: These factories are trying their best not to pollute the river any longer.
examples.zh: 这些工厂正在尽力不再污染河流。

examples.en: We had a picnic by the riverside.
examples.zh: 我们在河畔野餐。

proverbs.text: Confidence in yourself is the first step on the road to success.
proverbs.meaning: 自信是走向成功的第一步。

examples.en: We should drive carefully on the road.
examples.zh: 在道路上我们应该小心驾驶。

examples.en: You've made a fire fit to roast an ox.
examples.zh: 你生的火很旺，足以烤一头牛了。

examples.en: The thief tried to rob the old woman of her money.
examples.zh: 小偷试图抢老太太的钱。

examples.en: She worked like a robot.
examples.zh: 她工作起来如同一个机器人。

examples.en: Astronauts have brought back specimens of rock from the moon.
examples.zh: 宇航员从月球带回了岩石标本。

examples.en: She prefers rock music to classical.
examples.zh: 比起古典乐，她更喜欢摇滚乐。

examples.en: The boat rocked gently on the lake.
examples.zh: 小船在湖面上轻轻摇晃。

examples.en: He likes rock climbing very much.
examples.zh: 他非常喜欢攀岩。

examples.en: This space rocket carries two satellites.
examples.zh: 这枚宇宙火箭搭载了两颗卫星。

examples.en: Three boys were unhappy because they got no roles to play last week.
examples.zh: 三个男孩很不开心，因为上周他们没有分到表演角色。

examples.en: She bought a roll of paper.
examples.zh: 她买了一卷纸。

examples.en: There is a cat on the roof.
examples.zh: 屋顶上有一只猫。

examples.en: This is a three-metre-high room.
examples.zh: 这是一个3米高的房间。

examples.en: There is no room for your piano in your room.
examples.zh: 你房间里没地方放钢琴了。

examples.en: The roots of this plant go deep.
examples.zh: 这种植物的根扎得很深。

examples.en: Money is the root of all evil.
examples.zh: 金钱是万恶之源。

examples.en: Maggie asked me to cut the rope to a length of two metres.
examples.zh: 麦琪让我把绳子剪到两米长。

examples.en: He picked her a rose.
examples.zh: 他给她采了一朵玫瑰花。

teaching_notes.content:
size 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学

桌上那个机器人只有火柴盒那么大。

teaching_notes.content:
so that是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：so that+句子与in order/so as to+动词原形意思相同，在句中

例如：Kitty practises playing the piano after class so that she can win the competition.

为了能赢得比赛，姬蒂下课后练习弹钢琴。
Some girls in my company hardly have supper so that they can lose weight.

我公司里有些女孩为了减肥几乎不吃晚饭。

teaching_notes.content:
spend是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要掌握其固定搭配，及比较与cost,pay,take的用法区别：
1)sb. spend st.(in) doing sth./on sth.=it takes sb.st.to do sth.
例如：David spent two hours finishing/on his report last night.
=It took David two hours to finish his report last night.
昨晚戴维花了2个小时完成他的报告。
2)sb. spend money(in) doing sth./on sth.=sb. pay money for sth.=it costs sb.money
to do sth.
例如：My uncle spent huge amounts of money decorating the living room.
=It cost my uncle huge amounts of money to decorate the living room.
我叔叔花了一大笔钱来装饰客厅。
I spent $120 on my new dress.
=I paid $120 for my new dress.
我花了120美元买新连衣裙。

teaching_notes.content:
stop是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握stop to do与stop doing的用法区别：
1)stop to do sth.停下手中的动作，去做另外一件事。
例如：He stopped to talk with me.他停下来跟我谈话。
2) stop doing sth.停下手中正在做的事情。
例如：I want to ask my father to stop smoking.我想叫我的父亲戒烟。
3)stop...(from) doing sth.阻止做某事。
例如：No one can stop me from learning English.没有人能阻止我学习英语。

teaching_notes.content:
to是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法，及比较与on,in,at的用
法区别：
to指的是一个范围和另一个范围之间隔了段距离，表示“在某范围之外”,强调
两者是远离关系。
on指的是一个范围紧挨着另一个范围，表示“两地接壤”,强调两者为相邻关系。
in指的是在某范围之内，没有精确的地址。
at指在某一具体的地点，通常用于有精确的地址。
例如：Japan is to the east of China.日本位于中国的东边。
DPR is on the northeast of China.朝鲜在中国的东北面。
Beijing is in the north of China.北京在中国的北部。
The interview is arranged at an office on Middle Huaihai Road in Shanghai.
采访被安排在位于上海淮海中路的一个办公室里。

teaching_notes.content:
too是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法，及比较与either,also,
as well的用法区别。这四个词都是副词，都含有“也”的意思，可是它们的具
体用法却有比较明显的区别。
too表示“也”时，一般用在肯定句中，放在句末，前面通常用逗号。
例如：Jim likes red. I like red, too.吉姆喜欢红色，我也喜欢。
either表示“也”时，一般只用于否定句中，放在句末，前面通常用逗号。
例如：It won't do them any good, but it won't do them any harm, either.
这对他们没什么好处，但也没什么害处。
also经常放在句中，位于行为动词之前；位于系动词、助动词或情态动词之后。
例如：They also agree with me.他们也同意我的意见。
Mrs. Green can also sing the song in Chinese.
格林夫人也能用汉语唱这首歌。
as well的用法和 too一样，通常放在句末，但它前面通常不用逗号。
例如：He speaks English,and he knows French as well.他说英语，也懂法语。

teaching_notes.content:
unless是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要掌握其用法：
1) unless与if...not.意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I won't be allowed to play computer games unless I finish my homework.
=IfI don't finish my homework, I won't be allowed to play computer games.
除非我完成作业，否则不许玩电脑游戏。
You will be late for school unless you leave now.
=You will be late for school if you don't leave now.
如果你现在不走，上学就要迟到了。
2) unless与祈使句+or意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Unless you work harder,you'll not succeed in your new job.
=Work harder,or you'll not succeed in your new job.

teaching_notes.content:
until是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学
生一定要知道：not⋯ until与...when/after意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The boys didn't stop playing basketball until it was dark.
=The boys stopped playing basketball when it was dark
直到天黑，男孩们才停止打篮球。
Kitty won't believe it until she has seen it with her own eyes.
=Kitty will believe it after she has seen it with her own eyes.
直到亲眼所见，姬蒂才会相信。

examples.en: AprilFool's Day is an unusual holiday. You can play a trick on anybody around you.

examples.zh: 他把头枕在枕头上休息。

examples.en: What makes you so upset?
examples.zh: 是什么让你心烦意乱?

examples.en: You'll find it upstairs.
examples.zh: 你能在楼上找到。

examples.en: The smoke is rising upwards.
examples.zh: 烟正向上飘。

examples.en: The teacher urged us to finish our homework on time every day.
examples.zh: 老师敦促我们每天按时完成作业。

teaching_notes.content:
used to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：used to do与often did意思相同，在句中可以互换。

他们过去经常在我们小区踢足球。

examples.en: It is a very useful book for language learners to improve writing skills.
examples.zh: 对语言学习者提高写作能力来讲，这是一本非常有用的书。

examples.zh: 我们从这个有趣的比赛中获得了很多宝贵的经验。

examples.zh: 这些摄像机都这么好。我真的不知道该选哪个。

examples.zh: 我赞成你有关花零用钱的看法。这是合理的。

examples.zh: 在那个村里，水污染是最严重的问题之一。

examples.zh: 许多外国游客来中国主要是参观长城。

examples.zh: 每天旅客入住前，我们都要仔细检查他们的护照。

examples.zh: 志愿者们跟随运动员一起跑，以确保他们最终安全到达。

examples.zh: 为什么你不自愿提供消息呢?

examples.zh: 她获得40??选票。

examples.zh: 她量了量腰围，看看是否瘦了。

proverbs.text: Time and tide wait for no man.

examples.zh: 我们都知道，让别人久等是不礼貌的。

examples.zh: 他必须等待几个月才能获得签证。

examples.en: Mary's brothers work as waiters in a five-star hotel.
examples.zh: 玛丽的兄弟在一家五星级酒店当服务员。

examples.zh: 我们请那位女侍者再来一杯酒。

examples.en: Dona woke up and found herself in a hospital bed.
examples.zh: 多娜醒来发现自己躺在医院的病床上。

examples.zh: 清晨，杰瑞被桌上食物的诱人香味唤醒。

examples.zh: 晚饭后，我们在家附近散步时，天开始下雨了。

examples.zh: 我的钱包被人偷了。

examples.zh: 漫长的冬季过后，太阳的光线帮助温暖了大地。

examples.zh: 我们围坐在火边享受温暖。

examples.zh: 警察告诫孩子们不要在繁忙的马路边玩耍。

examples.en: The sign is a warning of danger.
examples.zh: 这个标志是危险警示。

examples.en: Mum has washed the carpet twice and now it's spotlessly clean.
examples.zh: 妈妈把地毯洗了两次，现在是一尘不染。

examples.zh: 这周末我得好好洗一下车。

examples.zh: 扔掉它多浪费!

examples.zh: 工厂不应该把废水排入河流。

examples.en: This watermelon is really sweet.
examples.zh: 这西瓜好甜呐。

teaching_notes.content:
weather是常考单词，是不可数名词。学生同时也要牢记其他常考的不可
数名词，如：advice(建议),fun(乐趣),furniture(家具),homework(家庭作业),
housework(家务),information(信息),music(音乐), news(新闻),progress(进步),
space(空间), tea(茶),work(工作)。
注意：有关液体和气体名称的单词一般也是不可数名词。

examples.en: Hundreds of internet service providers and web companies tested IPv6 on their websites.
examples.zh: 数百家互联网服务商和网络公司在他们网站上对互联网协议第6版进行了测试。

examples.en: I couldn't get much news of the exhibition of clean-energy products from the website.

examples.zh: 在上星期的班会上有人提了一些问题。

examples.zh: 她在做任何重要决定前都会权衡利弊。

examples.zh: 莉萨如何能在这么短的时间内减肥成功?

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are sold by weight.
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜是称重出售的。

examples.en: He received a warm welcome at Cambridge.
examples.zh: 他在剑桥受到了热烈的欢迎。

examples.en: The visitors will be welcomed when they come to Shanghai.
examples.zh: 游客来到上海时将受到热烈欢迎。

examples.zh: 不再受欢迎的成员很容易被排挤掉。

examples.zh: 我今天感到不舒服。

examples.zh: 查尔斯在今年的学校运动会上表现得多好啊!

examples.zh: 风从西面轻轻吹来。

examples.zh: 你叫什么名字?

teaching_notes.content:
what是常考单词，常出现在感叹句中，所以学生一定要注意其在以下感叹
句中的用法：
What a clever boy he is!=How clever the boy is!他是一个多么聪明的男孩啊!
What nice weather it is!= How nice the weather is!多么好的天气啊!
What beautiful flowers(they are)!=How beautiful the flowers are!
多美丽的鲜花啊!
What important information it is!多么重要的信息啊!
What useful advice he gave us!他给了我们多么有用的建议啊!
What interesting news it is!多么有趣的新闻啊!
What beautiful music he is playing!他在演奏多么美妙的音乐啊!
What good work he has done!他干得多漂亮呀!
What great fun it is to fly a kite here!在这儿放风筝多么有趣啊!
What an interesting news report it is!多么有趣的新闻报道啊!
What a great help it is to know English!掌握英语是多么有用啊!
What a good time they are having!他们玩得多开心啊!

examples.zh: 我一会儿就回来。

examples.en: Another world-famous building in Washington is the White House.
examples.zh: 华盛顿另一座世界著名的建筑物是白宫。

examples.en: Angels are usually shown in pictures dressed in white.
examples.zh: 画中的天使通常身穿白衣。

examples.en: Who do you think will win the first prize?
examples.zh: 你觉得谁会赢得第一名呢?

examples.en: Whoever comes to the party will get a small and lovely gift.
examples.zh: 无论谁来参加派对，都会得到一份小巧可爱的礼物。

teaching_notes.content:
whoever可引导让步状语从句(=no matter who),也可引导名词性从句。
例如：Whoever you ask,no one will reveal the secret.
无论你问谁，都不会有人泄露这个秘密。
Whoever breaks the rule will be punished.无论谁违反规则都会受到惩罚。

examples.en: Although Yuan Longping has left us, his remarkable achievements in hybrid research willalways have great influence on the whole world.
examples.zh: 袁隆平虽然离开了我们，但他在“杂交水稻”方面的杰出贡献将对整个世界产生巨大影响。

examples.en: Did you know whom Bill was waiting for?
examples.zh: 你知道比尔在等谁吗?

examples.en: Whose books are these?
examples.zh: 这些书是谁的?

examples.en: Nobody knows why Betty has become so forgetful in recent years.
examples.zh: 没有人知道为什么近年来贝蒂变得如此健忘。

teaching_notes.content:
why是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生
一定要掌握其用法：当线划在because部分或 to do 表示目的的部分，要用Why/
What...for 提问。
例如：He always has a headache because he always goes to bed too late.(对划线部
分提问)
Why does he always have a headache?为什么他总是头疼?
She got up early to catch the first bus.(对划线部分提问)
Why did she get up early?她为什么起得这么早?

examples.en: They came to a wide river.
examples.zh: 他们来到了一条宽阔的河边。

examples.en: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.
examples.zh: 随着中国的发展，汉语已成为一种国际语言，在世界各地被广泛使用。

examples.en: The town government has decided to widen this main street.
examples.zh: 市政府决定拓宽这条主街。

examples.en: Mr. Smith and his wife seldom drive their car to work, do they?
examples.zh: 史密斯先生和他的妻子很少开车上班，是吗?

meanings.meaning: 自然生长的，野的，野生的；荒凉的

examples.en: We should protect wild animals.
examples.zh: 我们应该保护野生动物。

examples.en: They went deep into the wilderness to explore the unknown.
examples.zh: 他们深入荒野去探索未知。

examples.en: We should protect the wildlife and their habitats.
examples.zh: 我们应该保护野生动物及其栖息地。八年级上

meanings.meaning: (表示将来)将；会；愿意；(表示提问)是否愿意；⋯⋯好吗?

proverbs.text: Will is power.

examples.en: Our headmaster will make a speech to the parents on the School Open Day.
examples.zh: 在学校开放日，我们的校长将向家长发表讲话。

examples.en: Will you go to the zoo with us tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天愿意和我们一起去动物园吗?

examples.en: Nothing can stop a man with a strong will from achieving success.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻挡一个意志坚定的人获得成功。

examples.en: Nobody knows which player will win the game until the last moment.
examples.zh: 不到最后一刻没人知道哪位运动员会赢得这场比赛。

examples.en: Wind is a motive power.
examples.zh: 风是一种动力。除词形拓展

examples.en: windy adj.
examples.zh: 有风的；起风的

examples.en: Could you possibly open that window for me?
examples.zh: 你能为我打开那扇窗吗?

examples.en: He loves to windsurf on the sea during the holidays.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在假期去海上做帆板运动。

examples.en: What fun it is to surf on a windy day!
examples.zh: 在有风的日子冲浪是多么有趣啊!

examples.en: You won't be able to make the best wine unless you choose the perfect grapes only.
examples.zh: =Choose the perfect grapes only, or you won't be able to make the best wine.只有选用极好的葡萄，才能酿造出最好的酒。

examples.en: Friendship is love without wings.
examples.zh: 友谊是无翼之爱。

examples.en: Wu Liangyong is one of the winners to get the State Preeminent Science and Technology Award.
examples.zh: 吴良镛是国家最高科学技术奖的获奖者之一。

examples.en: Miss Lin asked Dick if he was going to visit the Great Wall this winter.
examples.zh: 林小姐问迪克今年冬天他是否要去游览长城。

examples.en: Be careful! The wire is broken.
examples.zh: 小心!电线断了。

examples.en: He wired his family to let them know he had arrived safely.
examples.zh: 他给家人发电报告知已安全抵达。

proverbs.text: Wisdom in the mind is better than money in the hand.
proverbs.meaning: 胸中有知识，胜于手中有金钱。

examples.en: Wisdom is more precious than wealth.
examples.zh: 智慧比财富更珍贵。

meanings.meaning: 聪明的；明智的；充满智慧的

examples.en: They made a wise decision to leave there in a hurry before the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 他们做了一个明智的决定，大雨前匆忙离开了那里。

examples.en: My wish is to become a scientist when I grow up.What is yours,Betty?
examples.zh: 我的愿望是长大后成为一名科学家。贝蒂，你的愿望是什么?

examples.en: I wish you good health and a long life.
examples.zh: 祝您健康长寿。

teaching_notes.content:
wish是常考单词，学生要掌握这个单词的用法，并且比较与hope的用法
区别：
1)wish sb.to do sth.或wish sb.sth.
2) hope to do sth.或者后接宾语从句。
例如：I wish you to write to me.=I hope you will write to me.
我希望你能写信给我。

meanings.meaning: 与⋯⋯一道；跟⋯⋯一起；带有；具有；关于；以；和；用；有

examples.en: The famous actor often plays with his children in the park.
examples.zh: 那位著名演员经常和他的孩子们在公园玩。

examples.en: He passed me a knife to cut the birthday cake with.
examples.zh: 他递过来一把刀，让我切生日蛋糕。

examples.en: Although the expenses at Harvard University are high, students often pay less with the help of scholarships.
examples.zh: 虽然哈佛大学的学费昂贵，但学生在奖学金的帮助下往往只要支付一点点。

examples.en: The room is cooled with air conditioner.
examples.zh: 这房间用空调降温。

examples.en: You must use this instrument with great care.
examples.zh: 这种仪器使用时必须非常小心。

examples.en: I will help you with pleasure.
examples.zh: 我很乐意帮助你。

examples.en: I read English magazines with the help of a dictionary.
examples.zh: 我借助词典翻阅英文杂志。

examples.en: With the help of them, we could finish the work in time.
examples.zh: =They helped us so much that we could finish the work in time.在他们的帮助下，我们能够按时完成这项工作。

meanings.meaning: 在⋯⋯范围之内；在(某段时间)之内

examples.en: The house is within eyesight.
examples.zh: 这幢房子在视线范围之内。

examples.en: The firemen arrived at the scene within five minutes after the call.
examples.zh: 消防员在接到电话后5分钟之内就赶到了现场。

examples.en: Without the glasses, he can't see the words on the blackboard clearly.
examples.zh: 没戴眼镜，他看不清黑板上的字。

examples.en: Nobody can solve that complex case without gathering sufficient evidence.
examples.zh: 缺乏足够的证据，没人能侦破那个复杂的案件。

examples.en: They want to kill the wolf.
examples.zh: 他们想要把狼打死。

examples.en: These women doctors have saved many children's lives since they worked in the hospital.
examples.zh: 自从这些女医生在医院工作，她们救了很多孩子的生命。

examples.en: Many women are more independent than before because they have jobs and earn money.
examples.zh: 许多妇女比以前更独立，因为她们有工作、能赚钱。

meanings.meaning: 对⋯⋯感到疑惑；想知道；想弄明白；琢磨

examples.en: I wonder when the university campus in China will open to the public.
examples.zh: 我想知道中国的大学校园什么时候将对公众开放。

examples.en: Many people consider the internet to be one of the wonders of modern technology.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，互联网是现代科技的奇迹之一。

teaching_notes.content:
wonder是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以
学生一定要知道：wonder与want to know意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Mike's parents wonder whether he likes his new job.
=Mike's parents want to know whether he likes his new job.
麦克的父母想知道他是否喜欢他的新工作。

examples.en: We had such a wonderful time at his birthday party.
examples.zh: 在他的生日聚会上，我们度过了如此美好的时光。

examples.en: How wonderful this kind of computer is!
examples.zh: 这种电脑多棒啊!

examples.en: The park is like a wonderland with many beautiful flowers.
examples.zh: 这个公园就像一个开满美丽鲜花的仙境。八年级下

examples.en: Paper is made from wood.
examples.zh: 纸是由木头制成的。

examples.en: Mr. Smith has recently built a wooden bridge over his pool in the garden.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生最近在花园里的池塘上建造了一座木桥。

examples.en: We went for a walk in the woods.
examples.zh: 我们去树林里散步。

examples.en: This sweater is made of wool.
examples.zh: 这件毛衣是羊毛织的。

examples.en: I can't understand the sentence though there are no new words in it.
examples.zh: 我无法理解这句句子的意思，尽管句中没有新单词。

examples.en: Alice was so surprised to hear about the death of her good friend that she couldn't say a word.
examples.zh: 爱丽丝听到她好友去世的消息时太惊讶了，以至于一句话也说不出来。

proverbs.text: Work makes the workman.

examples.en: The firemen didn't stop working until ll he workers were saved.
examples.zh: =The firemen stopped working when allthe workers were saved.直到所有的工人都得救了，消防队员才停止工作。

examples.en: The watch just stopped working.
examples.zh: 这块手表刚坏了。

examples.en: What important work the scientists are doing!Let's learn from them.
examples.zh: 科学家所做的工作是多么重要啊!让我们向他们学习。

examples.en: Nothing can be learned well without hard work.
examples.zh: 不努力学习，什么也学不会。

examples.en: In my opinion, this is Rembrandt's greatest work.
examples.zh: 我认为这是伦勃朗最伟大的作品。

examples.en: Jessica worked out/dealt with/solved the physics problems without any help.
examples.zh: 在没有任何帮助的情况下，杰西卡解出了这道物理题。

examples.en: It wasn't too long before we had worked out a plan acceptable to all.
examples.zh: 没多久我们就制订出一个大家都能接受的计划。

examples.en: The workers were asked to go back to work at once.
examples.zh: 工人们被要求立刻回去工作。

proverbs.text: We all have our places in the world.

examples.en: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.
examples.zh: 每年上海吸引很多来自世界各地的游客。

examples.en: You have already tried your best, so you needn't worry too much about the exams.
examples.zh: 你已经尽力了，所以不必太担心这次考试。

examples.en: Mother's illness was always a great worry to me.
examples.zh: 母亲的病一直是我非常担心的事。

examples.en: You really don't have to worry about your weight. You look just right.
examples.zh: 真的，你不必担心你的体重。你看起来正好。

meanings.meaning: (bad的比较级)更坏的；更差的；更糟的

examples.en: If you don't take medicine,your cold will get worse than it was yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果你不吃药，你的感冒会比昨天更严重。

meanings.meaning: (bad的最高级)最坏的；最差的；最糟的

examples.en: It isn't worth spending so much time on gardening.
examples.zh: =It's a waste of time to spend so much time on gardening.不值得花这么多时间在园艺上。

meanings.meaning: 愿意；(客气地建议或邀请)将；将会

phrases.meaning: 想要；(表示喜欢、愿意)很想；很愿意

examples.en: She said she would come.
examples.zh: 她说过她会来的。

examples.en: Would you like me to show you how to work out the math problem?
examples.zh: 要我告诉你如何解答这道数学题吗?

meanings.meaning: /love(to)想要；(表示喜欢、愿意)很想；很愿意

examples.en: Would you like/love to go somewhere?
examples.zh: 你想要去个什么地方吗?

examples.en: They would rather use the colour like orange because it's much brighter than others.
examples.zh: 他们宁愿使用像橙色这种颜色，因为它比别的颜色鲜艳。

examples.en: My wound is stll painful.
examples.zh: 我的伤口还在痛。

examples.en: This is the wounded soldier.
examples.zh: 这就是那位受伤的战士。

examples.en: The two men were wrestling on the mat.
examples.zh: 这两个男人在垫子上摔跤。七年级下

examples.en: He wrote his first symphony when he was 16.
examples.zh: 他16岁时写了自己的第一部交响曲。

examples.en: She has written four novels.
examples.zh: 她写了4篇小说。

examples.en: I wrote to let him know that I had arrived in Beijing.
examples.zh: 我写信告诉他我已到达北京。

examples.en: Who is the writer of the book War and Peace?
examples.zh: 《战争与和平》这部书的作者是谁?

meanings.meaning: 错误的；不正常的；有病的

examples.en: It's wrong of you to make fun of the disabled boy. You should apologise to him.
examples.zh: 你取笑那个残疾男孩是不对的。你应该向他道歉。

meanings.meaning: 院子；码；(某种用途的)区域，场地

examples.en: There is a beautiful garden in the yard.
examples.zh: 院子里有一个漂亮的花园。

examples.en: The football field is 115 yards long.
examples.zh: 足球场长115码。

examples.en: The farmer collects fresh eggs every morning from the chicken yard.
examples.zh: 农民每天早晨从鸡舍里捡新鲜的鸡蛋。

examples.en: What changeable weather it is this year!
examples.zh: 今年的天气真是多变啊!

examples.en: Yellow is my favourite colour.
examples.zh: 黄色是我最喜欢的颜色。

examples.en: Grandma's garden is full of bright yellow flowers.
examples.zh: 外婆的花园种满了明艳的黄色花卉。

examples.en: We're hoping that they will say yes to our proposals.
examples.zh: 我们希望他们对我们的提议予以肯定。

examples.en: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two to one.
examples.zh: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士队2比1打败了美国队。

examples.en: What an amazing story he told us the day before yesterday!
examples.zh: 前天他告诉我们的是一个多么令人惊叹的故事啊!

examples.en: Has Danny given up smoking yet?
examples.zh: 丹尼戒烟了吗?

examples.en: The girl hasn't finished the project herself yet.
examples.zh: 这个女孩自己还没有完成项目。

examples.en: Do you have any low-fat yogurt?
examples.zh: 你有没有低脂的酸奶?

examples.en: It's very kind of you.
examples.zh: 你真好。

examples.en: I want to thank all of you for your hard work and dedication.
examples.zh: 我要感谢你们所有人的辛勤工作和奉献。

proverbs.text: A young idler,an old beggar.
proverbs.meaning: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。

examples.en: She must be at least forty, but she likes dressing up as a young girl.
examples.zh: 她至少有40岁了，但她喜欢打扮成年轻的姑娘。

examples.en: Show me your hands.
examples.zh: 把你的手伸出来给我看。

examples.en: Thank you for your cooperation.
examples.zh: 谢谢你们的合作。

meanings.meaning: 你的(所有物);你们的(所有物)

examples.en: Which pen is yours?
examples.zh: 哪支笔是你的?

examples.en: These are ours; yours are on the table.
examples.zh: 这些是我们的，你们的在桌子上。

examples.en: You should take care of yourself.
examples.zh: 你应该照顾好自己。

examples.en: Did you enjoy yourselves at the party last night?
examples.zh: 你们昨晚在派对上玩得开心吗?

examples.en: The singer is regarded as a representative of the youth of her generation.
examples.zh: 这位歌手被视为她那一代年轻人的典型代表。

examples.en: We saw a group of zebras in the zoo.
examples.zh: 我们在动物园里看到了一群斑马。

examples.en: It's a sunny late winter day,just a few degrees above zero.
examples.zh: 这是晚冬晴朗的一天，只有零上几度。

examples.en: There are two zeros in 1008.
examples.zh: 在1008中有两个零。

examples.en: Please take me to the zoo.
examples.zh: 请带我去动物园。
